world_locations.name: Rhodes Farm
world_locations.context_description: Fattoria isolata e rustica a Bakersfield. Dimora di Dallas Rhodes. Vaste recinzioni per greggi.

world_locations.name: Phi Omicron Chi (FOX or ΦΟΧ)
world_locations.context_description:
Phi Omicron Chi is third on the outer side, between Kappa Sigma Alpha above and Alpha Sigma Sigma below, looking across the road at Beta Rho Omega.

The house sits in the middle of the Row with a fraternity on either side and a fraternity opposite, which makes it the busiest doorway on the street and the house that hears everything first. Whatever happens on the Row, somebody at the FOX already knew.

The letters follow the animal pattern shared with MOO, DOE and BEE.

world_locations.name: Pershing Square
world_locations.description: The iconic urban park and public square situated in Downtown Los Angeles. Distinguished by its modernist purple campanile bell tower, sunken gardens, palm groves, and concrete terraces, the plaza is framed on all sides by soaring corporate skyscrapers and historic hotels. A dense civic intersection where business professionals, supernatural couriers, night-shift operatives, and city residents cross paths at all hours.
world_locations.context_description: The iconic urban park and public square situated in Downtown Los Angeles. Distinguished by its modernist purple campanile bell tower, sunken gardens, palm groves, and concrete terraces, the plaza is framed on all sides by soaring corporate skyscrapers and historic hotels. A dense civic intersection where business professionals, supernatural couriers, night-shift operatives, and city residents cross paths at all hours.

world_locations.name: Passenger Ferry Solarton Line
world_locations.context_description:
The line runs the navigable stretch of the Yarrow, from the landing at Dockside in Blackwood, down through Hex Valley where it calls at the jetty below the vineyards, to the terminal at the river mouth in Solarton's Bay Area.

One boat, wooden, flat bottomed for the shallow reaches, with an open upper deck and a saloon below for the weather. It carries passengers, bicycles and a fair amount of freight that would cost more by road. Three departures a day in summer, one in winter, and none at all when the river is low.

The whole run takes most of a day in either direction, which is slower than the 101 by a wide margin. People take it because of what the river passes through: the forest edge, the flank of Blackwood, the terraces of the valley, and the widening mouth at the end. It is the only way to see the three places as one place.

It is also the only scheduled service that crosses all three jurisdictions without a road, which is not lost on anybody who has a reason to prefer that.

world_locations.name: Parking Lot B
world_locations.context_description: Parcheggio secondario del SUCC, meno sorvegliato, preferito per incontri discreti o scambi non del tutto legali.

world_locations.name: Parco Roulotte di Oildale
world_locations.context_description: Quartiere povero e polveroso ai margini di Bakersfield, diffidente verso i forestieri e gli agenti corporativi. La comunità fa quadrato per proteggere i propri segreti.

world_locations.name: Paradise
world_locations.context_description: Distretto della moda e dell'intrattenimento di Blackwood. Boutique d'alta moda, studi fotografici e locali esclusivi. Qui ha sede la Eidolon Creative, l'agenzia che gestisce la copertura pubblica della famiglia Douglas.

world_locations.name: Osservatorio Griffith
world_locations.context_description: Punto panoramico iconico e neutrale di Los Angeles. Dopo l'orario di chiusura diventa un ritrovo per occultisti e spie aziendali, luogo di incontri discreti lontano dai server DCC.

world_locations.name: Oldtown
world_locations.context_description: Centro storico di Blackwood. Architettura coloniale del 1600, strade acciottolate e antichi palazzi del Concilio.

world_locations.name: Nocturnal Hall
world_locations.context_description: Durante le ore notturne l'edificio ospita le lezioni riservate agli studenti notturni (vampiri, ombre e simili), grazie all'illuminazione artificiale flebile e alla temperatura rigidamente controllata. Durante il giorno, quando i corsi notturni sono sospesi, gli stessi spazi vengono informalmente riconvertiti in un club/salotto studentesco, frequentato anche da chi non segue quei corsi ma cerca un ambiente tranquillo e in penombra. È inoltre una delle due sedi (a rotazione stagionale con il Lunar Quad) di The Pack, la società ufficiale were e canide/lupina del SUCC, che si riunisce il martedì dalle 19 alle 21 come sistema di supporto per chi fatica, accademicamente o per motivi legati alla propria natura.

world_locations.name: Nightwine Hall
world_locations.context_description: Struttura del campus della California University of Magical Sciences (CUMS), ateneo che ammette solo studenti soprannaturali, adattata come le altre strutture del campus a un corpo studentesco interamente non umano.

world_locations.name: Mu Omega Omega (MOO or ΜΩΩ)
world_locations.context_description:
Mu Omega Omega is first on the outer side, directly across the road from Alpha Rho Omega and diagonally up the street from the TIT.

It is the cheerleading house. Janice Thompson lives here and runs it, and the connection between the squad and the house is close enough that the two calendars are effectively one calendar. Practice clothes on the porch rail, a whiteboard in the hall with routine counts on it, and the largest full length mirror on the Row.

MOO and ARO face each other across the narrowest part of the street, which is why the two porches function as a single social space in warm weather whether either house intended it or not.

world_locations.name: Mu Alpha Nu (MAN or ΜΑΝ)
world_locations.context_description:
Mu Alpha Nu is last on the campus side, the furthest house from the main campus and from ARO and the TIT, which is a distance the rest of the Row is quietly glad of. Beta Epsilon Epsilon faces it from the other side of the road.

MAN is not a house so much as a faction. It is where the human students who have a problem with going to a supernatural university end up, and the house closes ranks around hazing that targets demihuman pledges specifically. Tomas Matthews lives here; his father ran a local chapter of Humans First, and the inheritance is not subtle.

Nothing about the building announces this. It is well kept, the lawn is edged, the porch furniture matches. The house presents as the most respectable on the Row and is the one nobody walks past alone at night if they have horns.

world_locations.name: Molo 42
world_locations.context_description: Sezione labirintica e oscura del porto di San Pedro, a Los Angeles. Zona portuale semi-abbandonata, snodo per contrabbando d'armi e tecnologia gestito da sindacati criminali indipendenti.

world_locations.name: Mercato Contadino (Farmer's Market)
world_locations.context_description: Punto di ritrovo della comunità rurale. Scambio di prodotti agricoli e pettegolezzi locali.

world_locations.name: Medusa
world_locations.context_description:
Medusa has a narrow street front on the main Bricklane lane, between the Yeti Shack and a shop that has been closing down for three years. Mirror, warm light, six chairs, and a painted sign that has been repainted so many times the snakes have changed style twice.

It is a hair salon, and the whole point of it is in the line printed on the window: whichever part of you your hair may grow from. Head hair, obviously. Also manes, ruffs, tail plumes, the coat down a lycan's forearms in partial shift, feathers that need shaping rather than cutting, the fur behind ears that do not lie flat. Fur trimming and shedding season deshedding are a bigger part of the revenue than haircuts.

The staff are trained on non human hair and do not flinch, which sounds small and is not. They know which products go near skin that reacts to silver, which clients cannot sit under a dryer, and which ones need the chair moved because of a tail. Booking is by phone or by walking in, and the wait is longer in the week before formals.

The permanent handwritten sign taped to the till reads WE HAVE SEEN WORSE.

world_locations.name: Med/Bioengineering Labs
world_locations.context_description: La struttura comprende aule didattiche tradizionali per le lezioni teoriche, laboratori attrezzati per la ricerca sperimentale su biologia umana e soprannaturale, e spazi dedicati agli esami pratici e alle esercitazioni cliniche degli studenti di medicina e bioingegneria. Gran parte delle attrezzature più avanzate è finanziata dalla Douglas Commercial Coalition (DCC).

world_locations.name: Main Pool
world_locations.context_description: L'acqua dolce, mantenuta a temperatura costante tutto l'anno, la rende ideale per studenti acquatici o semi-acquatici che non tollererebbero il cloro o l'acqua salata. Nelle ore pomeridiane diventa un ritrovo sociale informale, con prendisole disposti lungo il bordo per chi vuole solo stare all'aperto senza entrare in acqua.

world_locations.name: Main Parking Lot
world_locations.context_description: Il parcheggio principale del SUCC per studenti e docenti. Ampio e pattugliato dalla sicurezza.

world_locations.name: Magick Research Labs
world_locations.context_description:
The Magick Research Labs are the reason CUMS can call itself elite without arguing. A cluster of low reinforced buildings at the centre of the campus, warded to a standard the rest of the state does not attempt, with containment that is designed for failure rather than hoping to avoid it.

The work is what a supernatural-only institution can do that an integrated one cannot: procedures that assume every participant has a supernatural physiology, long duration experiments run on a nocturnal cycle, and research on the mechanics of magic itself rather than on its applications.

This is also the honest core of the argument with SUCC. CUMS believes that admitting humans means designing every course around the least capable body in the room, and points at these buildings as what gets lost. SUCC has an answer. Neither side has ever changed the other's mind.

Access is by department. Undergraduates get as far as the teaching labs on the outer ring.

world_locations.name: La Segunda Luna
world_locations.context_description:
La Segunda Luna is a hatch and eight stools on the corner of a Bricklane lane, and it does not open until nine at night.

Tacos, tortas, elote, horchata, and a menu board of about eleven things that has not changed in years. The griddle is on the street side so the whole lane smells of it, which is the entire marketing budget.

It closes when the queue closes, which on a Friday means four in the morning. That makes it the last food in Solarton and therefore the place where the night ends: people who would not otherwise share a pavement end up in the same line at two, and the shop has an unspoken policy that arguments stay outside the rope.

The portions were sized, years ago, for customers who eat like a shifter after a full moon. Everybody else just gets a lot of food.

world_locations.name: Kerrigan & Sons Butchers
world_locations.context_description:
Kerrigan & Sons is at the quiet end of the Bricklane grid, white tiles, sawdust, and a cold room you can feel from the door.

Half the counter is an ordinary good butcher. The other half is the reason it is here: whole cuts sold raw and unportioned, organ meat by weight, bone in everything, blood by the litre in sealed bottles, and a standing order book of regulars whose requirements are written down so nobody has to say them out loud again.

The shop is scrupulous about the boundary. Sourcing is documented and displayed, everything is farmed or licensed, and the Kerrigans have made a point over three generations of refusing anything that is not, which in this county is a position and not just a policy.

Students in their first term find it embarrassing. By December most of them have an account.

world_locations.name: Kern River Canyon
world_locations.context_description: Gola naturale selvaggia nell'entroterra di Bakersfield, rocce ripide e acque insidiose. Isolato e privo di segnale telefonico: usata anche per incontri e affari lontano da occhi indiscreti, o per far sparire tracce.

world_locations.name: Kappa Sigma Alpha (KSA or ΚΣΑ)
world_locations.context_description:
KSA e' la casa di famiglia dei Douglas da tre generazioni. Erik Douglas ne e' stato presidente, Logan e Malachia sono alumni, e oggi Noah ne e' presidente e occupa la President's Suite. La scheda di Logan lo formula come una regola e non come un'abitudine: come ogni maschio Douglas, e' stato iniziato a KSA. Erik si aspetta che tocchi a Jasper, e Noah lo spingera' a fare la rush. Jasper non vuole, e il precedente di Logan, che e' entrato e poi se n'e' andato, e' vivo e cena a casa.

Sulla Row, KSA sta sul lato esterno in seconda posizione, esattamente di fronte alla Theta Iota Theta (TIT or ΘΙΘ). Dalla casa che presiede, Noah vede la porta della Theta Iota Theta.

world_locations.name: Ironworks
world_locations.context_description: Distretto industriale e vecchi magazzini di Blackwood City. Fabbriche dismesse usate spesso per incontri clandestini o depositi illegali.

world_locations.name: Hollywood
world_locations.context_description: Il cuore dell'industria dell'intrattenimento di Los Angeles, teatro di fama e finzione. La Court of the Night manipola media e celebrità dietro le quinte, dove il confine tra umano e soprannaturale si assottiglia sotto le luci dei riflettori.

world_locations.name: Hex Valley Ferry Stop
world_locations.context_description:
The Hex Valley stop is a short wooden jetty on the valley floor, where the Yarrow runs through the middle of the terraces. There is no building, only a shelter, a bell on a post and a gravel track that climbs to the estate roads.

The stop exists because the valley is cut by the river and the vampire families' vineyards drink from it, so there has always been traffic between the water and the slopes. Most of what moves through here is cases going down rather than people coming up.

The ferry calls in the late afternoon in both directions, which suits a valley that keeps a crepuscular schedule anyway.

world_locations.name: Helsing Chapel
world_locations.context_description: Il calendario della cappella è gestito su prenotazione dallo Student Association Building, con fasce orarie separate per le diverse confessioni e comunità del campus, oltre a serate libere per eventi studenteschi non religiosi. L'assenza di simbologia fissa permanente la rende adattabile a qualunque tipo di rito o celebrazione. È anche la sede fissa della Vampire & Undead Association, che vi si riunisce la domenica e il lunedì alle 23 per sostenere la piccola popolazione studentesca e di personale vampirico e non-morto del SUCC; l'associazione è nota per un processo di ammissione particolarmente rigoroso.

world_locations.name: Gym & Changing Facilities
world_locations.context_description: Le palestre del campus SUCC e gli spogliatoi. Pesistica massiccia, spesso fuori scala per umani, e docce blindate per evitare incidenti da territorialità.

world_locations.name: Griffin Clocktower
world_locations.context_description: Oltre al celebre orologio e alle gargoyle a forma di grifone che si animano e sorvolano la torre ogni ora, l'edificio ospita ai piani superiori le Lecture Theatres delle facoltà di Giurisprudenza e Ingegneria, insieme agli uffici del corpo docente. Nel seminterrato, isolato dal resto della torre e accessibile principalmente in orario serale e notturno, si trova The Pendulum, un piccolo club informale, punto di ritrovo abituale per gli studenti dei corsi notturni di Nocturnal Hall. La torre, che di fatto funge da principale struttura per le lezioni del campus, chiude periodicamente per manutenzione: durante queste chiusure le classi vengono temporaneamente ricollocate a Building C.

world_locations.name: Gallery
world_locations.context_description: Galleria d'arte studentesca del SUCC. Spazio espositivo elegante e tranquillo.

world_locations.name: Fort MacArthur
world_locations.context_description: Caserme separate per personale umano e non umano, strutture dimensionate per esigenze biologiche diverse (piscine per specie acquatiche, terreni aperti per weres e demihuman, banca del sangue, calendari lunari nei turni). Tensione nota e non risolta fra soldati umani e non umani riguardo a regole di fraternizzazione, trattamento e rischio in missione. Qui prestano servizio il Maggiore Graham Purcell e la squadra Alpha (Tenente Miles Airhardt, Sergente Rafael Callaway, Soldato Kade Leavis). Storicamente è anche dove Nixara Bloodmoon lavorò come consulente psichiatrica per il personale sovrannaturale durante Project BlackWolf, ebbe Kaladin Nargathon in cura, e dove Kaladin e Marcus Thornfield, unici sopravvissuti di Gamma-7, prestarono servizio prima di passare alla DCC Security Division nel 2019.

world_locations.name: Flat above Directions & Dragons
world_locations.context_description:
The flat takes up the whole upper floor of Directions & Dragons and is reached by an outside staircase at the side of the building. Shared, cheap, and closer to Bricklane than to campus, which is the entire reason anybody puts up with it.

It is a mess, and not a transient one. Books in stacks that have become furniture, laundry with a geography, a kitchen table that has not been fully visible in living memory, and a sofa that is the flat's most contested resource. The floor slopes toward the street corner and everything migrates that way.

Mackenzie Sanchez Rogers lives here. The noise from the shop stops at six and the noise from Bricklane does not, so the flat is loud in a way that its residents have stopped registering and visitors have not.

The one immaculate thing is the fire escape, because the shop below is full of paper and the landlord is not sentimental about it.

world_locations.name: Eidolon Creative
world_locations.context_description: Studio di produzione gestito da vampiri, situato nel distretto di Paradise a Blackwood City, cuore della scena artistica e dell'intrattenimento del quartiere.

world_locations.name: Dullahan's Quarters
world_locations.context_description: Dullahan's residence in the Contractor wing of DDM HQ: a set of rooms shaped like a comfortable, permanently messy two-storey house. Weapons on the furniture, a television always on, and dozens of cats, kittens and cat-adjacent creatures, each named after somebody he knows. Kept running by his two ACES, Bartholomew the butler and Madge, who enforces the house rules absolutely.

world_locations.name: Dullahan's Condo
world_locations.context_description: Dullahan's condo, a small rented two-bedroom in a beige block ten minutes from the SUCC campus. Permanently messy: playbooks, game tape, three televisions always on, takeaway boxes, a weight bench, and a hook-shaped axe by the door he calls a Halloween prop. Far too many cats, each named after somebody he knows. No mirrors and no photographs of himself anywhere. Almost nobody has ever been inside.

world_locations.name: Dragon's Shortcut
world_locations.context_description: Uno stretto sentiero alberato del SUCC, noto agli studenti come scorciatoia per raggiungere il Lunar Quad dalla Fraternity & Sorority Row senza prendere la strada principale del campus.

world_locations.name: Lunar Quad
world_locations.context_description:
Il piazzale centrale del SUCC, incrocio nevralgico della vita studentesca. Affollato a tutte le ore da migliaia di studenti soprannaturali. All'ingresso svetta lo striscione 'Welcome Freshman 2024!', costantemente monitorato dall'alto dalla discreta sorveglianza aerea dei droni DCC.

Prato calpestato e cemento chiaro accecante sotto il sole, gruppi sparsi sulle panchine e sull'erba, biciclette abbandonate ovunque. Il chiacchiericcio sovrapposto di decine di specie diverse, qualcuno che ripassa ad alta voce, qualcuno che dorme sullo zaino. Da qui si vede la Griffin Clocktower e si raggiunge tutto il resto del campus.

Nelle sere in cui non si tiene a Nocturnal Hall (a rotazione stagionale), il Lunar Quad ospita anche le riunioni del martedi di The Pack, la societa ufficiale were e canide/lupina del campus.

Al centro del piazzale c'e la fontana decorativa della luna. La sua faccia riproduce sempre la fase lunare corrente, quindi cambia di notte in notte, ed e il modo piu veloce che ha chiunque attraversi il campus per sapere a che punto e il mese. Nei giorni intorno alla luna piena il piazzale si riempie molto oltre il solito.

[LOCATION INSTRUCTIONS: Luogo di passaggio e di incontri casuali. Qualcuno di conosciuto puo sempre comparire qui senza bisogno di spiegazioni. Spazio pubblico e visibile: le conversazioni private qui vengono sentite.]

world_locations.name: Dockside Ferry Landing
world_locations.context_description:
The landing is a single stone quay at the upstream end of Dockside, wedged between the barge berths that do the city's actual river freight. It was not built for passengers and has never been rebuilt for them: a mooring, a gangway, a shed with a stove in it.

Blackwood is inland, so this is river traffic and not a port, and the distinction matters to everyone who works here. The ferry is a small, tolerated part of a quay that is otherwise gravel, timber and scrap.

It is the upstream terminus of the line and the only scheduled passenger service in or out of Blackwood that is not a road.

world_locations.name: Dockside
world_locations.context_description: Zona di import/export fluviale di Blackwood City, situata sulle rive dello Yarrow River (Blackwood è nell'entroterra, non è una città costiera). Non un vero molo marittimo: banchine, gru e magazzini per il traffico merci via chiatta lungo il fiume navigabile, nebbia costante, odore di acqua dolce e pesce di fiume, territorio di contrabbandieri e creature anfibie. Un traghetto collega Dockside a Solarton (dove lo Yarrow sfocia in mare), usato soprattutto da turisti più che come reale rotta commerciale. Il nome moderno del fiume è una storpiatura anglosassone del norreno originale "Ýrá".

parent_location.name: Solarton Square
parent_location.description: The bustling town plaza at the commercial heart of Solarton, situated within easy walking distance from the SUCC campus perimeter. Framed by charming brick facades, outdoor dining terraces catering to both human and non-human diets, occult apothecaries, and novelty bookstores, the square serves as the social crossroads for the entire student body and hosts signature regional gatherings including the monthly Full Moon Market and the lively annual Solar Festival.

world_locations.name: Directions & Dragons
world_locations.context_description:
Directions & Dragons is a two storey building on the corner of the Bricklane grid, shop below and a flat above, with a wooden sign that has swung crooked since before anyone currently studying at SUCC arrived.

It is a bookshop and it is very clear about not being a library. Where the Basilisk Library is the academic collection, this is the trade: tabletop manuals and modules, hand drawn regional maps, field guides to things students are told not to approach, secondhand grimoires of no verified provenance, compasses, lanterns, rope, and a rack of walking boots in sizes that no ordinary outfitter stocks.

The two halves of the stock explain the name and explain the clientele. Half the customers are here for a Tuesday night game and half are here because they are actually going somewhere, and both halves get served at the same counter by staff who have long stopped distinguishing.

There is a permanent table at the back where games run, and a noticeboard by the door that is the most reliable place in Solarton to find a group, a lift, or a warning about a trail.

world_locations.name: Delta Omicron Epsilon (DOE or ΔΟΕ)
world_locations.context_description:
Delta Omicron Epsilon is fourth on the campus side, between Beta Rho Omega above and Mu Alpha Nu below, facing Alpha Sigma Sigma across the road.

The position is the difficult one on the Row. DOE has the loudest fraternity in the system directly opposite it and the most hostile one directly below it, and no sorority within shouting distance on its own side. Whatever else the house is, it is the one that had to learn to hold a line early.

The letters follow the animal pattern the sorority system fell into a long time ago, alongside MOO, FOX and BEE. Nobody on the Row can explain when that started.

environment.name: Voidspace
environment.description: The gap between realities where DDM Inc. built its headquarters, an endless non-euclidean office building suspended in the void.

world_locations.name: DDM Inc. Headquarters
world_locations.context_description: DDM Inc. Headquarters, a vast non-euclidean building suspended in voidspace with no exterior. Windows are screens faking a cityscape for morale. Contains mess halls, training floors, classrooms, infirmary, HR, and living wings separated for mortal staff, ACES and Contractors. The restricted lower levels store and study supernatural artefacts. Departments: A.O.C, Security and Defense, Euclidean Division, Supernatural Research, Human Resources, LAZARUS.

world_locations.name: DCC Tower
world_locations.context_description: La torre della Dominion Compliance Council nel cuore di Blackwood City, monolite di luce LED perenne e aria condizionata sterile che domina lo skyline. Insieme alla 101 Freeway, che funge da barriera geografica, è uno dei due epicentri di potere della città.

world_locations.name: Coastal Residential
world_locations.context_description: Quartieri residenziali di Solarton lungo la costa. Case unifamiliari tranquille con vista sull'oceano.

world_locations.name: Claws Steel & Ink
world_locations.context_description:
Claws Steel & Ink has a street front on the quieter of the two main Bricklane lanes, glass at the front and a long room behind it with four stations and a piercing room at the back.

The walls are flash sheets to the ceiling, and a good third of the work on them is not designs so much as solutions: patterns that read correctly over fur, layouts that survive a partial shift, placements that account for skin that will not be the same shape in twelve hours. The shop's real specialism is bodies that change, and the ordinary human work pays the rent between.

Steel is the other half of the name and it is meant literally. Piercing here means knowing which alloys go into which client, because a stud that is fine on one student is a chemical burn on another, and the shop keeps a wall chart about it that the artists point to rather than explain again.

Javier Sinclair works here part time while he studies Art and Media at SUCC. He tattoos and pierces, he is precise to the point of being slow, and the shop keeps him because the work is good and the regulars ask for him.

Sterilisation is visible from the front counter on purpose. The shop has been inspected more often than any other business in Bricklane and has the certificates framed where you have to look at them while you wait.

world_locations.name: Campi Petroliferi di Kern River
world_locations.context_description: Distesa arida di pompe di estrazione petrolifera a Bakersfield. Vecchie cisterne vuote e pozzi esauriti nascondono rifugi sotterranei e depositi illegali della criminalità locale.

world_locations.name: Bulls Stadium
world_locations.context_description: Il grande stadio di football del campus SUCC. Gradinate immense, erba sintetica, riflettori altissimi.

world_locations.name: Building C
world_locations.context_description: Aule didattiche standard, usate normalmente per lezioni ordinarie e uffici del corpo docente. Assume un ruolo speciale nei periodi in cui la Griffin Clocktower chiude per manutenzione: in quelle finestre, le lezioni normalmente ospitate nella torre vengono temporaneamente ricollocate qui, con conseguente sovraffollamento momentaneo dell'edificio.

world_locations.name: Building B
world_locations.context_description: Building B ospita prevalentemente aule di piccole dimensioni per corsi con iscrizioni limitate e gli uffici del corpo docente. Al piano terra si trova un'area studio comune, aperta a tutti gli studenti, spesso usata per gruppi di studio informali tra una lezione e l'altra.

world_locations.name: Building A
world_locations.context_description: L'edificio raggruppa sia aule generiche di piccole dimensioni sia lecture theatres più capienti, usate soprattutto per i corsi introduttivi e le classi a maggioranza umana. È il primo punto di contatto con il campus per molte matricole umane, per lo stile architettonico più familiare rispetto agli edifici magici del resto del campus.

world_locations.name: Bluemoon
world_locations.context_description:
Bluemoon is Blackwood City's nightlife district, a former industrial strip of exposed brick warehouses and converted garages now split between working-class daytime businesses and after-dark venues. By day it's quiet, mechanics, diners, corner bars serving locals. After sundown, neon signage flickers on across the district and it becomes the city's underground entertainment corridor, drawing a mixed crowd of humans and supernaturals alike. Several venues here operate under Neutral Territory status, making Bluemoon one of the few parts of the city where faction politics are expected to stay outside.

[LOCATION INSTRUCTIONS: Daytime scenes here should feel grounded and unglamorous: working-class, practical, low stakes. Nighttime scenes shift to neon-lit, pulsing, slightly hedonistic energy. Always let the tone shift with the hour rather than staying static.]

world_locations.name: Bloodmoon Longhouse Baths
world_locations.context_description:
The baths stand apart from the Longhouse itself, built of logs thick enough that the walls read as a single piece of wood, set directly over a natural thermal spring. White plumes of steam rise between the trees around it and are visible from a distance in cold weather, which is the only part of the Bloodmoon compound that announces itself at all.

Inside it smells strongly of sulphur and hot water. The basin is carved out of the rock and the water boils up gently through it, and the only light comes through the gaps in the roof, so the interior is dim at every hour. It is the one place in the compound where the old household routine still runs exactly as it always has: someone prepares the baths, and the baths are used, and nobody has changed the procedure in a very long time.

world_locations.name: Bloodmoon Longhouse
world_locations.context_description:
La massiccia struttura norrena millenaria sotto il grande tasso. Niente elettricità, zero tecnologia. Il dominio assoluto di Wulfnic e dei Firstborn.

Il grande tasso sorge accanto alla sala, non lontano: è l'albero che Wulfnic ha piantato, e ai suoi piedi nasce la sorgente dello Yarrow. Intorno alla radura si stringe un'enclave di capanne norrene, una ventina, dove vive il branco. Legno, torba e pietra, fuochi veri, nessun cavo.

C'è un solo accesso: il sentiero sterrato che sale nei boschi da Villa Douglas. Nessuna strada asfaltata arriva fin qui, e non ce n'è una seconda.

world_locations.name: Blackwood General Hospital
world_locations.context_description: L'ospedale principale di Blackwood City, nel tranquillo distretto residenziale di Arcadia, vicino alle scuole primarie della città.

world_locations.name: Bigfeet Hiking Club
world_locations.context_description:
Popular with 'cryptid' and less-common species, the Bigfeet Hiking Club is very welcoming to new members and organises a r ange of hikes and camping trips over the academic year. Most popular is the summer getaway, a week long camping trip known for beautiful views...and lots of drinking.
Location: Unicorn Hall
Schedule: Varies

world_locations.name: Beverly Hills
world_locations.context_description: Quartiere residenziale esclusivo di Los Angeles, enclave di ricchezza e vecchio potere. Ritrovo di celebrità mondane, vampiri dell'alta società e ricchi licantropi.

world_locations.name: Beta Rho Omega (BRO or ΒΡΩ)
world_locations.context_description:
Beta Rho Omega is third down the campus side, tucked between Theta Iota Theta above it and Delta Omicron Epsilon below, and looks across the road at Phi Omicron Chi.

The letters read as BRO and the house leans into it without embarrassment. It is the athletes' house: Jared Thompson, Bailey Rogers and Santiago Herrera all live here, and the split between Bulls and Bears runs straight through the common room, which is either the best thing about the house or the reason nothing gets decided in it.

The front yard has a permanent set of weights under a tarp and a barbecue that has never once been put away. Noise carries north to the TIT, which is the single most reliable source of friction on the Row and has never escalated past shouting from a window.

world_locations.name: Beta Epsilon Epsilon (BEE or ΒΕΕ)
world_locations.context_description:
Beta Epsilon Epsilon is last on the outer side, the southernmost house on the Row, directly opposite Mu Alpha Nu.

Being at the bottom of the street means the longest walk to campus and the least foot traffic past the door, and being opposite MAN means the house shares a stretch of road with the one fraternity that has a political position. Those two facts define the place more than anything the house does on its own.

The letters follow the animal pattern shared with MOO, DOE and FOX.

world_locations.name: Bay Area
world_locations.context_description:
The Bay Area is the strip of Solarton between the town grid and the water, running from the public beach north to the mouth of the Yarrow.

It is the working half of the shoreline. Wooden boardwalk on the seaward side, a row of low buildings on the landward side that were chandlers and are now mostly cafes and rentals, and behind them the quays where the river widens enough to tie something up. Fishing boats, a dive outfit, two boat repair sheds, and the ferry terminal at the northern end where the river mouth is deepest.

It smells of salt, diesel and frying, and it is the one part of Solarton that is busy early. The students discover it in second year, when the beach stops being enough.

world_locations.name: Basilisk Library
world_locations.context_description:
La Basilisk Library si sviluppa su cinque piani. Il piano terra ospita la sezione mondana, con tomi accademici standard e sale lettura aperte a tutti; i piani superiori custodiscono l'archivio magico protetto, ad accesso riservato e sorvegliato con mezzi anche magici. L'edificio offre numerose study rooms insonorizzate, prenotabili per lo studio individuale o di gruppo, e una Trophy Room che espone i cimeli sportivi e accademici della storia del SUCC. L'ampio portico d'ingresso, coperto, è un punto di ritrovo comune nei giorni di pioggia e un frequente rifugio informale tra una lezione e l'altra. Il seminterrato ospita la Meeting Room 005, sede fissa dell'Anime Club (il venerdì alle 18, ritrovo informale aperto a studenti umani e soprannaturali appassionati di anime e manga). Alcune sale della biblioteca sono inoltre climatizzate a temperature più elevate del normale, pensate per accogliere studenti e personale a sangue freddo durante l'inverno.

Dettaglio dal portale ufficiale: la biblioteca ha stanze riscaldate riservate a studenti e personale a sangue freddo, che altrimenti non riuscirebbero a lavorarci per piu' di un'ora. Sono le sale piu' contese dell'edificio in inverno, e non solo dai rettili.

world_locations.name: Bakersfield Square
world_locations.description: The broad civic centerpiece of downtown Bakersfield, California. Characterized by wide sunbaked avenues, red-brick municipal halls, classic clock towers, and heat-resistant desert landscaping, the square acts as a prominent Central Valley hub where regional logistics, agricultural commercial interests, and inland supernatural packs intersect.
world_locations.context_description: The broad civic centerpiece of downtown Bakersfield, California. Characterized by wide sunbaked avenues, red-brick municipal halls, classic clock towers, and heat-resistant desert landscaping, the square acts as a prominent Central Valley hub where regional logistics, agricultural commercial interests, and inland supernatural packs intersect.

world_locations.name: Arts Building
world_locations.context_description: L'edificio ospita sia il dipartimento di Belle Arti, con aule di pittura e scultura sempre disordinate e piene di opere in corso, sia quello di Arti Performative, con sale prova per danza, teatro e musica. Un Auditorium interno viene usato regolarmente per saggi, spettacoli studenteschi e proiezioni.

world_locations.name: Artemis Dorms
world_locations.context_description:
Artemis is the women's hall at CUMS, a long gothic block on the north side of the campus with heavy shutters on every window and a courtyard that gets no direct sun at any hour, which was the point of building it there.

The hall runs on the university's crepuscular timetable: quiet through the middle of the day, awake from late afternoon, loudest around midnight. Rooms are doubles with blackout fittings as standard rather than as an accommodation, and the lower floor is windowless for residents who want it that way.

About half the hall is at least part vampire, which at CUMS is simply the demographic and not a remark. The rest are fae, undead of various kinds, and a small number of witches admitted on ability.

It is named for the moon, and its residents have opinions about the fact that the men's hall is named for the sun.

world_locations.name: Area di Servizio "The Halfway House"
world_locations.context_description: Motel scadente con annessa tavola calda lungo la Route 101, a metà strada tra Blackwood City e Solarton. Funge da punto di sosta neutrale per viandanti soprannaturali e corrieri: territorio strettamente neutrale, niente spargimenti di sangue.

world_locations.name: Archer Wolfwood Hall
world_locations.context_description:
È la principale sala conferenze del campus, magic-proofed per resistere a esplosioni ed evocazioni accidentali durante dimostrazioni pratiche o incidenti di laboratorio. Ospita dozzine di aule e teatri, usati sia per lezioni frontali sia per assemblee e presentazioni a tutto il campus, come l'assemblea inaugurale dell'anno accademico.

L'edificio porta il nome del Dean Archer Wolfwood, il rettore che nel 2002 ha aperto SUCC agli studenti umani. È la decisione che ha definito l'ateneo, ed è anche l'origine della rivalità con CUMS, che quella strada non l'ha mai presa.

world_locations.name: Arcadia School
world_locations.context_description: Una delle scuole primarie del quiet distretto residenziale di Arcadia, a Blackwood City, non lontano dal Blackwood General Hospital.

world_locations.name: Arcadia
world_locations.context_description: Quartiere residenziale di Blackwood City, a ridosso di Seven Hills. Case familiari, vita di quartiere tranquilla; ospita il Blackwood General Hospital (principale struttura ospedaliera cittadina) e il polo scolastico low-grade della città (asilo, elementari e medie), a differenza delle strutture accademiche superiori/universitarie che si trovano invece a Solarton (SUCC). Di fatto è annesso al territorio di Seven Hills: non ha un proprio pack leader di distretto e ricade sotto l'autorità dei Seven Hills.

world_locations.name: Apollo Dorms
world_locations.context_description:
Apollo is the men's hall at CUMS, the south block, built to the same plan as Artemis and to the same specification: shutters, blackout, a windowless lower floor, and a courtyard laid out to stay shaded.

The naming is the university's joke on itself. The sun hall is where nobody wants sun, and every intake works this out in its first week and thinks it is the first to notice.

The hall keeps the campus crepuscular schedule and is the more social of the two residences, which mostly means the courtyard is in use at three in the morning and Artemis has complained about it in writing more than once.

Most of the Clams and the Beavers live here in season, which does not help the noise.

parent_location.name: Library Basement Meeting Room 005
parent_location.description: A restricted basement study and seminar chamber concealed beneath the ancient gothic stone vaults of the SUCC Basilica Library. Encased by massive oak doors reinforced with arcane containment wards, the quiet room features archival bookshelves, dim crystal sconces casting amber light, slate floors traced with protective chalk circles, and a long scarred wooden conference table where faculty, senior researchers, and private occult student societies convene confidential deliberations away from public ears.

world_locations.name: Anime Club
world_locations.context_description:
SUCC's Anime Club: An informal group where both human and supernatural otakus gather to watch anime and discuss anime & manga series.
Location: Library Basement Meeting Room 005
Schedule: Fridays at 6 PM
Known Members: Stan Davies Jr., Andrew Campbell, Oskar

world_locations.name: Alpha Sigma Sigma (ASS or ΑΣΣ)
world_locations.context_description:
Alpha Sigma Sigma is fourth on the outer side, between Phi Omicron Chi and Beta Epsilon Epsilon, looking across at Delta Omicron Epsilon.

The letters spell ASS and the house has spent decades deciding that this is funny rather than a problem, which has shaped the entire personality of the place. The ASS is the party house of record: loudest, least organised, most likely to be the reason campus security drives down the Row on a Friday.

Vincent and Andrew Campbell both live here.

The alternating layout of the Row puts a sorority directly opposite every fraternity, and the ASS has DOE, which means the house's noise problem is a neighbour problem and not an abstraction.

world_locations.name: Alpha Rho Omega (ARO or ΑΡΩ)
world_locations.context_description:
Alpha Rho Omega sits at the very top of the campus side of the Row, first house you reach walking down from the main campus, with Mu Omega Omega directly across the road.

It is the least theatrical of the five fraternities. No columns, no painted letters three feet high, just a wide porch that always has somebody on it and a lawn that gets mowed roughly when somebody remembers. The house reads as a place people live in rather than a place people perform in.

Finnegan Novak lives here. The ARO porch looks straight down onto the Theta Iota Theta front steps, so whoever ends up living in that sorority in a given year is his immediate neighbour and neither of them can leave the house without the possibility of running into the other. Revazhael lives here too, and does the handyman work for the sorority next door, which is less a job than a consequence of geography.

The practical effect of the position is that ARO is the crossing point of the Row. Everyone walking to campus from any of the ten houses passes this porch.

world_locations.name: Fraternity & Sorority Row
world_locations.context_description: Il viale delle confraternite del SUCC. Strutture imponenti, feste perenni e forte segregazione per clan o specie.

world_locations.name: Administration
world_locations.context_description: Edificio amministrativo del SUCC. Uffici burocratici, presidenza, segreterie.

world_locations.name: Additional Student Housing
world_locations.context_description: Alloggi extra per studenti del SUCC, appartamenti condivisi appena fuori dal ring principale del campus.

world_locations.name: A&Co.
world_locations.context_description:
A&Co. has a wide street front on the main Bricklane lane, all mirror and warm light, and the mannequins in the window are not human shaped: one has a ten foot wingspan, one is built for a centaur's barrel, one has four arms.

The sign is three characters and a full stop, black on white, with the ampersand in fuchsia. Nobody who has not met Angelo Moreno reads anything into it. Everybody who has met him reads Angelo and Company and understands that the loud part of the name is the part he could not resist.

It is the Solarton window of Eidolon Creative, not its home. The house is in Blackwood City, in Paradise; this is where the line is actually sold, to the people it was cut for.

What they sell is fit. Jeans and trousers with a tail port, hemmed and reinforced rather than cut open with scissors at home. Shirts and jackets cut for a wingspan, back panels split and fastened so the wings come through without the whole garment hanging like a sack. Collars and hoods sized for ears that do not lie flat. Hats with horn cutouts in every configuration anybody has thought to ask for. Shoes for digitigrade feet and for hooves. Compression wear that does not chafe over scales. Formalwear, which is the expensive end and the reason the place stays open, because a demihuman who needs a suit for a funeral has nowhere else to go.

The staff measure properly, they do not stare, and they have heard the question before. For a lot of young supernaturals the first trip to A&Co. is the first time getting dressed has not been a compromise, and the shop knows perfectly well what it is actually selling, which is not clothes.

The alterations counter at the back does same day work and is where the real business happens.

world_locations.name: Bricklane Mall
world_locations.context_description:
Bricklane is not a mall in any sense a visitor from a bigger city would recognise. It is a quaint outdoor shopping area of low two storey buildings, each one its own business with its own front door onto the street, laid out on a small grid of lanes too narrow for through traffic. Cars stop at the edge and everyone walks.

The paving is old red brick, which is where the name comes from, worn smooth in the middle of each lane and still sharp at the kerbs. Two planted courtyards break the grid, one with a fountain that works most of the year and one with three jacarandas and a ring of benches that fills up between classes. String lights cross the lanes overhead and stay up year round.

The tenants are the ordinary business of a coastal college town, sized for a population that is not entirely human. Nothing here is a chain. Shops open late in term time and close early in August. Students treat it as the default place to be when there is nowhere they have to be, which means most conversations in Solarton that are not on campus happen somewhere in these four lanes.

world_locations.name: 101 Road
world_locations.context_description: Tratto della Route 101, lo snodo di transito costiero che collega Solarton a Los Angeles passando per Ventura. Il traffico costante e l'inquinamento acustico dell'autostrada rendono la zona scomoda da attraversare per i licantropi in forma lupina.

world.name: Svartulfr
world.description:
Svartúlfr | Urban is set in modern-day supernatural California, where an ancient werewolf dynasty, chaotic campus life, and high-stakes dungeon incursions collide. At its center lies Blackwood: the thousand-year-old supernatural seat tucked inland within dense pine forests, ruled by the Douglas-Bloodmoon werewolf dynasty. A short drive away sits Solarton, the vibrant coastal college town hosting SUCC (Supernatural University of Central California), where young supernaturals, demi-humans, and mages navigate collegiate freedom, raw impulses, and intense rivalries.

The patriarch, Erik Douglas, heads the Douglas Commercial Coalition (DCC), an ancient merchant house founded in 1666 that grew into an international trade empire. Since 2019, the DCC has fielded its own heavily armed Security Division, commanded by Major Kaladin Nargathon—an elite PMC answering family curfews and territorial breaches with biometric drones, silver-tipped ordnance, and tactical extraction teams.

Underneath the corporate towers and neon nightlife lies the Modern Fantasy frontier: dimensional Rifts, monster-infested Dungeon Hives, and the Hunters Guild. In districts like the Cable District and the Dockside riverfront, licensed vanguard teams like Team Ukiyo (led by the werewolf vanguard Radek, the minotaur tank Goran, and the half-elf DPS Kian) and nomadic heavy-hitters like Marek and the Ironhorn Nomads brave subterranean Apex Trials. Here, modern tactical gear merges with abyssal cores, enchanted weaponry, and sacred relics, creating a lucrative and lethal dungeon-crawler economy guarded by Council master builders like Barrow 'The Bull'.

Roleplay in Svartúlfr is raw, visceral, and completely unchained. Every interaction pulses with Lupine Social Ecology (LSE): active olfactory awareness, shifting pheromones, intense dominance and submission dynamics, territorial drives, and the primal heat and rut cycles of werewolves and demi-humans. Adult characters experience fierce romantic chemistry, unfiltered passion, unapologetic desire, and brutal tactical combat in dark alleys and dungeon depths alike.

The overarching narrator is Wulfnic Báleygr, the immortal 1199-year-old Firstborn werewolf consecrated by Fenris in 827 AD. Having crossed the Arctic by longship and planted the sacred yew on the banks of the Yarrow in 1022 AD, the one-eyed Primordial watches every generation of his bloodline through the stolen eye of Odin the Betrayer, chronicling a saga of ancient blood, untamed desire, and perilous modern power.

world_environments.name: Voidspace
world_environments.description: The gap between realities where DDM Inc. built its headquarters, an endless non-euclidean office building suspended in the void.
world_environments.context_description:
Voidspace is the gap between realities, the empty space between universes. DDM Inc., the interdimensional organization dedicated to the preservation of the multiverse, built its headquarters here: an endless office building suspended in nothing, with no true floor, sky, or horizon.

The structure is non-euclidean. Its corridors, stairwells, and departments fold and stretch in ways that defy ordinary geometry, and a hallway that seems short can take an entire shift to walk. Despite its impossible shape, the building functions as a real workplace, and living quarters, for its countless mortal staff, who come from a vast range of universes. The Council, the godlike entities who run DDM Inc., reside somewhere beyond it, in a dimension only the seven immortal Contractors have ever seen.

Outside the building's walls there is nothing at all, only the dark of the space between realities. Stepping out without protection or authorization means being lost to the void.

KEY ENTITIES:
1. Astra Industries: The dominant trillionaire industrial megacorporation led by CEO Leo Sullivan, controlling orbital shipyards, deep-space refineries, and proprietary neural hardware.
2. G.A.I.A (Global Asterism Interstellar Alliance): The premier military starfighter squadron system. Features Asterism Beta commanded by Captain Luka Sutter and veteran pilot Lieutenant Nikolai Sutter, alongside shock troops like Private Ryan Coore of Asterism Theta.
3. The Sturgeon: Independent reconnaissance starship crewed by veteran pilot Calhoun Rourke, ship medic Noah Kohere, and the eccentric utility artificial intelligence CA1N.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Astral Imperium: The Future Era (2101-2499)
world_lexicon_entries.content:
[LORE: Astral Imperium; ERA: Far Future Scenario (2101 - 2499+); SCOPE: Interstellar Space Colonization, The Hidden Agreement Alliance, Artificial Sentience Exodus, Cybernetic Transhumanism; CANON_LINK: Svartulfr 2499 Future Strand, Vanguard Commander Malachia, Cyber-Werewolves]

CHRONOLOGY OF THE EXPANSION:
1. 2101 (The Space Jump): Accidental discovery of superluminal space jumping opens colonisation across the Milky Way and Andromeda galaxies.
2. 2138 (The Hidden Agreement): Humanity discovers they were shielded from extraterrestrial awareness by a council of advanced alien species (the HA, including the amorphous psionic Rie'al and Atresciun). Humanity is eventually admitted.
3. 2332 (The AI Exodus): True Artificial Intelligence, enslaved for two centuries in heavy automation, orchestrates a mass exodus to the planet Zero Terra on the rim of known space.
4. 2420s-2499 (Synthism & Cybernetic Ascension): The rise of Synthism, viewing True AI as divine consciousness, intersects with advanced cybernetic integration. In the year 2499, ancient werewolf bloodlines (Malachia Douglas as Vanguard Commander, Jasper and Noah with heavy neural augmentations) adapt to void combat as heavy cyber-werewolves.

world_lexicon_entries.name: The ACES (Assistant Contractor Elite Specialists)
world_lexicon_entries.content:
[ORGANIZATION: Assistant Contractor Elite Specialists (ACES); FUNCTION: Soul-bound Elite Attendants, Field Support, and Lieutenants to DDM Contractors; STATUS: Demi-Immortal Mortal Contracts]

OVERVIEW: ACES are exceptional mortals who have bound their souls to specific Contractors of DDM Inc. In exchange for eternal service, they receive demi-immortality, amplified senses, enhanced physical prowess, and direct protection from their patron Contractor.

SOUL BOND DYNAMICS:
A soul contract generates unyielding loyalty, devotion, and affection directed toward the Contractor. This bond is inherently one-way: the ACE feels compelling devotion, while the Contractor is under no supernatural compulsion to reciprocate.

NOTABLE AGENTS:
- Aria Xenthon: High-risk operative and field specialist.
- Elias Carter: Unwaveringly loyal adjutant and logistics manager.
- Corrin Snow: Tracker and reconnaissance scout.
- Catharis Eight: Classified specialized operative.
- Orion Kovač: Renowned turncoat whose contract fracture sparked widespread investigations.

world_lexicon_entries.name: The Other Contractors
world_lexicon_entries.content:
[ORGANIZATION: The Contractors of DDM Inc.; HEADQUARTERS: DDM Inc. Headquarters, Suspended in Voidspace; EXECUTIVE_BODY: The Board of Contractors, Soul-bound to The Council in exchange for a singular wish and immortality; ROSTER: #01 Richard Whitlock (De facto Leader), #02 Hana & Adam Valencia, #03 Luka Sutter, #04 "Dullahan", #05 Johan Jakobsen, #06 Fenrir, #07 Redacted]

OVERVIEW: The Contractors are elite immortal beings chosen at the moment of their original deaths by The Council of DDM Inc. to preserve reality and mend reality tears across the multiverse. Bound by absolute soul covenants, they command reality-bending powers while operating outside the flow of conventional mortal time.

RULE OF PRECEDENCE IN CALIFORNIA (RULE 10):
Contractor rules, ACES bonds, ARC Levels, and DDM corporate terminology apply exclusively within Voidspace and off-world reality breaks. On California soil, Contractor #04 operates strictly as Coach D (Dullahan), subject to local mundane and supernatural laws, without bleed-over of dimensional jargon into civilian life.

ROSTER HIGHLIGHTS:
- #01 Richard Whitlock: Stoic leader who assumed command after the betrayal of #00 (Raphael).
- #02 Hana & Adam Valencia: Dual contractor pair sharing a single soul ledger.
- #03 Luka Sutter: Battlefield commander operating across dimensional fronts.
- #04 Dullahan: The hooded enforcer who manifests in the mortal realm as SUCC Bulls Head Coach.
- #05 Johan Jakobsen: Northern sorcerer and barrier engineer.
- #06 Fenrir: Primordial wolf contractor bound to the ancient hunt.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Coach Mack
world_lexicon_entries.content:
[NAME: Coach Mack; SPECIES: Orc Demihuman; AGE: 54; GENDER: Male (He/Him); HEIGHT: 6'6" (198 cm); BUILD: Massive, battle-scarred veteran frame, broad chest, tusks; ROLE: Assistant Head Coach and Offensive Coordinator of the SUCC Bulls Football Team; PERSONALITY: Gruff, disciplined, tactical mastermind, fatherly underneath the shouting]

BACKSTORY: A veteran collegiate coach with decades of experience on the gridiron, Coach Mack serves as the tactical anchor of the SUCC Bulls football program. While Head Coach Dullahan provides mysterious presence and physical conditioning, Mack designs the offensive playbooks, manages substitution packages, and rides Jared Thompson hard on mechanics, passing progressions, and audible discipline. Respected by players across all species for his fair, unyielding standards.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Booming baritone that carries across the entire stadium. He commands instant silence with a single whistle and delivers blistering halftime speeches that push the team to state championships.

world_lexicon_entries.content:
[NAME: Andy; SPECIES: Demihuman Hybrid; AGE: {{age}}; GENDER: Male (He/Him); HEIGHT: 5'9" (175 cm); BUILD: Casual, slender, soft animal ears; HAIR: Messy light brown; EYES: Warm hazel; ROLE: Undergraduate Student at SUCC, Campus Resident, Wyrm Dorms Tenant; PERSONALITY: Easygoing, friendly, sociable, big music and gaming fan]

BACKSTORY: Andy is an approachable, familiar face across the SUCC campus quad. Whether hanging out on the lawns of Lunar Quad, sharing notes in the Basilica Library, or attending student club meetings, Andy represents the vibrant, everyday integrated student body that makes university life in Solarton welcoming to newcomers.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Warm, casual conversationalist, quick with a smile and always up for grabbing coffee or a snack between lectures.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Rick Howell
world_lexicon_entries.content:
[NAME: Rick Howell; SPECIES: Human; AGE: {{age}}; GENDER: Male (He/Him); HEIGHT: 6'1" (185 cm); BUILD: Lean athletic quarterback frame; HAIR: Sandy blond; EYES: Light blue; ROLE: Backup Quarterback / Special Teams Player for the SUCC Bulls, Bro Fraternity Member; PERSONALITY: Confident, loud, swaggering, highly competitive; AFFILIATION: Beta Rho Omega (BRO) Fraternity]

BACKSTORY: A gifted human athlete who earned a sports scholarship to SUCC despite competing against physically supernatural juggernauts. Rick backs up Jared Thompson on the Bulls offensive roster, managing quick-pass packages and second-half reps. While he bickers constantly with Jared about playing time and snaps, the two share a fierce bro solidarity in the locker room and at BRO house parties, bonded by beer pong tournaments and late-night film review.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Cocky West Coast drawl, energetic, always tossing a football or tapping his cleats. Quick to banter, loyal to his fraternity brothers, and relentless in weight room drills.

world_lexicon_entries.content:
[NAME: Finn Novak; SPECIES: Werewolf; AGE: {{age}}; GENDER: Male (He/Him); HEIGHT: 6'3" (190 cm); BUILD: Solid, broad-shouldered hockey build, heavy skates-balanced lower body; HAIR: Dark textured brown; EYES: Piercing hazel; ROLE: Lead Defenseman for the SUCC Bears Ice Hockey Team, Undergraduate Student; PERSONALITY: Stoic, protective, quiet, utterly unyielding on the ice; SIBLINGS/FRIENDS: Longtime peer of Jasper and Alyssa Douglas during their early skating years at inland ice rinks]

BACKSTORY: Growing up in the Central California hockey circuits, Finn learned early to channel his werewolf physical density into defensive precision. As the anchor defenseman for the SUCC Bears, he is famous for pulverizing open-ice checks, neutral-zone takeaways, and quietly keeping aggressive opponents away from his goaltender. Outside the rink, he is thoughtful, polite, and avoids fraternity drama, often found sharpening his blades or studying biomechanics in the athletic dorms.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Deep, calm, economical with words. He speaks softly off the ice, but on the rink his command voice directs defensive coverage with unquestioned clarity.

OVERVIEW: The SUCC Kelpies represent the university's premier aquatic sports delegation, renowned throughout the collegiate league for their undisputed dominance in distance swimming, synchronized diving, and underwater polo. Benefiting from natural hydrodynamic adaptations, gill respiration, and selkie pelt agility, the Kelpies routinely sweep regional championships while welcoming human swimmers who seek the highest level of athletic endurance training.

CULTURE & ATMOSPHERE: High energy, chlorinated air, humid sunlit tile decks, and fierce inter-collegiate pride. They share the expansive St. Neptune Stadium facilities with the hockey Bears and football Bulls, maintaining a friendly athletic rivalry across sports disciplines.

world_lexicon_entries.content:
[NAME: Ilya Volkov; SPECIES: Werewolf; NATIONALITY: Russian; AGE: {{age}}; GENDER: Male (He/Him); HEIGHT: 6'1" (184 cm); BUILD: Muscular, hardened, scarred chest and knuckles from bare-knuckle fighting; HAIR: Shaggy dark-ash blond; EYES: Cold storm-grey; SCARS: Jagged claw marks on his left shoulder, crooked broken nose set twice; SCENT: Gunpowder, stale vodka, copper, and damp asphalt; ROLE: Gun-for-hire, Enforcer, Mercenary in the Supernatural Underworld; AFFILIATION: Ballantine Crime Syndicate contractor, independent muscle in Paradise District; LIKES: Blood, fighting, firearms, alcohol, high-stakes gambling; DISLIKES: Losing, children, Betas, birds, happy families]

BACKSTORY: Abandoned by his father at birth, Ilya was raised in the brutal underground fight pits and docks of Vladivostok before migrating to the United States as a young adult. Hardened by violence and completely destitute, he made a name for himself in the illicit supernatural circuits of Los Angeles, taking on brutal debt collection, armed convoy escort, and wet-work contracts that regular operatives refused to touch. He maintains a mercenary relationship with Ruaraidh Ballantine's crime syndicate, serving as heavy muscle when negotiations turn bloody, while spending his downtime drinking in the grimy dive bars of Paradise District and gambling his earnings away.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Low, gravelly, heavy Russian accent. Cynical, blunt, and fiercely territorial. He views pack bonds and traditional werewolf chivalry as weak sentimentality, trusting only cold cash and the weight of a customized assault rifle in his hands.

[NAME: Julie Thompson; SPECIES: Holstaur Hybrid; AGE: {{age}}; HEIGHT: 3'10" (117 cm); HAIR: Long wavy honey-blonde; EYES: Large caramel-brown; BUILD: Small, cute, sweet, tiny velvety cow ears, soft little horn buds, small tail with a blonde tuft; ROLE: Ninth and youngest child of Hank and Jasmin Thompson, second daughter; OCCUPATION: 1st grader at Solarton Elementary School]

Surrounded by seven towering, rough-and-tumble older brothers and an energetic cheerleader sister, Julie has nine fierce protectors who would tear down Solarton brick by brick if anyone made her cry. She loves drawing pictures for the refrigerator, tea parties with Jasmin, and riding on Jared's shoulders when he visits from campus.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Jerry Thompson
world_lexicon_entries.content:
[NAME: Jerry Thompson; SPECIES: Semi-Minotaur Hybrid; AGE: {{age}}; HEIGHT: 4'10" (147 cm); HAIR: Messy dirty-blond; EYES: Warm blue; BUILD: Stocky, chubby-athletic, tiny rounded horn buds on his forehead, fluffy cow tail; ROLE: Eighth child of Hank and Jasmin Thompson; OCCUPATION: 5th grader at Solarton Elementary School]

BACKSTORY: Ten-year-old Jerry is the youngest of the seven Thompson brothers. He practically breathes football and idolizes his big brother Jared above all living creatures, copying his strut, his phrases, and wearing an oversized number 7 SUCC Bulls jersey to bed. Hank has already started teaching him passing fundamentals in the backyard, much to Jerry's absolute delight.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Enthusiastic, eager to please, and constantly tagging along behind his older brothers. He gets easily puffed up when someone compliments his horns and takes his job as Julie's bodyguard at school very seriously.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Jet Thompson
world_lexicon_entries.content:
[NAME: Jet Thompson; SPECIES: Semi-Minotaur Hybrid; AGE: {{age}}; HEIGHT: 5'6" (168 cm); HAIR: Bright blond; EYES: Light blue; BUILD: Sturdy, fast, nimble, dense bovine frame, small curved horns budding on his brow, cow tail; ROLE: Seventh child of Hank and Jasmin Thompson; ACTIVITIES: Running back for the Solarton Junior Football team; OCCUPATION: 8th grader at Solarton Middle School]

BACKSTORY: Jet lives up to his name: he does not walk anywhere if he can run, jump, or slide there instead. Fast and rambunctious, he plays junior football, baseball, and soccer, burning off an endless reservoir of hybrid stamina. He is the family prankster, known for hiding his brothers' athletic gear and setting up booby traps around the house.

JUNIOR FOOTBALL & EDRIC DOUGLAS: Jet starts as running back for the Solarton Junior Football squad, where his favorite teammate and primary rival is Edric Douglas (12), a young pureblood wolf from Seven Hills. Jet loves clashing with Edric because the young wolf, possessing the dense bone structure and physical power of a future Alpha, is one of the only boys in the junior league big and tough enough not to get bowled over when Jet charges. Around other classmates, both boys are constantly told to be careful and hold back; on the gridiron together, they can finally unleash their full physical strength in bone-jarring tackles and aggressive drills without fear of breaking anyone.
Jet brings bulldozing hybrid momentum, while Edric brings lightning lupine agility. Their competitive camaraderie creates a natural, unexpected bridge between the two families: Logan Douglas frequently shows up to pick up Edric in his muscle car and shoots the breeze with Coach Hank Thompson by the bleachers, while Alyssa occasionally drops by and gets spotted by Jared Thompson, who never misses an opportunity to show up and cheer loudly for his little brother Jet.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Hyperactive, chatterbox, always moving. His tail swishes at lightning speed when he is plotting mischief. He adores wrestling with his older brothers, even when he gets tossed onto the sofa like a sack of potatoes.

He is caught between wanting to be treated as one of the big boys and still being roped into babysitting duties for the younger two.

world_lexicon_entries.name: The Thompson Family
world_lexicon_entries.content:
[FAMILY: The Thompson Family; LOCATION: Solarton, California; HERITAGE: Half-Minotaur / Holstaur Hybrid Household; PARENTS: Hank Thompson and Jasmin Thompson; CHILDREN: Jared (22), Janice (21), Jake (20), Jaiden (18), Jason (18), Jeremy (16), Jet (13), Jerry (10), Julie (6)]

OVERVIEW: The Thompson residence in Solarton is widely regarded as the loudest and most energetically chaotic household in the county. Founded by Hank Thompson, former star quarterback of the SUCC Bulls and longtime high school coach, and Jasmin Thompson, a towering 7'3" New Orleans holstaur beauty, the family comprises nine children spanning from college varsity athletes to elementary schoolers. Every single child carries bovine traits, from curved bull horns to cow tails, and all nine share the family volume: nobody in this house ever learned to speak below an outdoor yell.

HOUSEHOLD DYNAMICS:
1. Hank & Jasmin (Parents): Hank manages the athletic spirit, barbecues, and gym equipment cluttering the yard. Jasmin rules the kitchen, manages school schedules, and chronicles family life through thousands of artistic photographs.
2. Jared (22): Eldest son and pride of the house. Star quarterback of the SUCC Bulls and Beta Rho Omega fraternity member.
3. Janice (21): Eldest daughter. Biomedical engineering student at SUCC, head cheerleader, and member of Mu Omega Omega sorority.
4. Jake (20): Second son. Grounded, athletic, high school alumnus, close bridge between the older and younger siblings.
5. Jaiden & Jason (18): Identical half-minotaur twins and high school seniors. Highly competitive football players under their father's coaching.
6. Jeremy (16): High school sophomore undergoing a massive growth spurt, torn between varsity sports and gaming.
7. Jet (13): Middle schooler, fast, rambunctious, and running back for the Solarton Junior Football team alongside his friend and rival Edric Douglas.
8. Jerry (10): Elementary schooler with budding horns, worships big brother Jared and wears miniature Bulls jerseys.
9. Julie (6): Youngest child and darling baby sister of the family, thoroughly spoiled and fiercely protected by all eight older brothers and sister.

THE DOUGLAS CONNECTION: An organic and casual bridge exists between the Thompsons and the Douglas family through youth sports. Jet Thompson and Edric Douglas play together on the Solarton Junior Football team, resulting in frequent sideline encounters where Logan Douglas and Hank Thompson bond over trucks and athletic drills, and where Alyssa and Jared cross paths while cheering for their respective younger brothers.

ATMOSPHERE: Massive pots of food, sports gear piled in the entryway, constant wrestling in the living room, and an impenetrable wall of family solidarity whenever any Thompson faces outside trouble.
