world_lexicon_entries.name: Arma Base
world_lexicon_entries.content: A dependable, concealed self-defense weapon kept close for personal protection in the unpredictable supernatural underworld. Well-maintained, balanced, and discreet enough to carry under casual clothing or within an inner jacket pocket.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Portafoglio
world_lexicon_entries.content: Un portafoglio in pelle consumata contenente documenti personali, tessere d'accesso, qualche carta di credito e i contanti sopravvissuti alla serata precedente.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Servizio di Ghosting del Mercato Nero
world_lexicon_entries.content: A high-end underworld fencing operation managed by Marek and the Ironhorn Nomads. It enables hunter teams to make Grade S cores and monster organs 'vanish' from official DMHA raid logs, laundering the illicit materials through private corporate collectors and depositing clean, untraceable funds into overseas accounts.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Barriere a Permeabilità Selettiva (Selective Permeability Barrier)
world_lexicon_entries.content: An advanced tactical warding spell mastered by Alyssa Bloodmoon. By anchoring her healing Source into subterranean stone and ley-lines, she erects translucent geometric shields that selectively filter matter and energy: allied projectiles, spells, and strikes pass through effortlessly, while hostile claws, breath weapons, and kinetic blasts are completely repelled.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Dungeon Drenanti (Mana-Feeding Dungeons)
world_lexicon_entries.content: Certain volatile rifts actively absorb ambient and personal magical energies from living organisms within their confines. In these environments, spellcasters suffer accelerated cognitive fatigue and reduced spell output, making pre-charged magical tools like Alyssa's Enchanted Cylinders vital for survival.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Ciclo Notturno dei Dungeon (Dungeon Night Mode)
world_lexicon_entries.content: A dangerous environmental phenomenon occurring within deeper dungeon rifts. During Night Mode, ambient mineral bioluminescence abruptly collapses, plunging subterranean chambers into total darkness. Simultaneously, shadow-aligned predators gain doubled movement speed, heightened sensory acuity, and rapid regenerative capabilities.

world_lexicon_entries.name: DMHA (Dungeon & Monster Hazard Administration)
world_lexicon_entries.content: The supreme administrative regulatory body governing meta-human incursions, rift stabilization, hunter licensing, and monster containment across North America. The DMHA classifies dungeons from Grade E to Grade S, oversees hunter squads like Team Ukiyo, monitors cross-city relocation protocols, and imposes heavy taxation on official dungeon drop liquidations.

world_lexicon_entries.name: CONCIERGE App
world_lexicon_entries.content: A secure, proprietary mobile application developed by HSK Consulting for managing high-risk freelance assignments, physical evaluation audits, and classified monster research contracts. Features a minimalist monochrome interface, biometric encryption, and untraceable digital escrow payouts.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Dungeon Core (Hive Apex Core)
world_lexicon_entries.content: A pulsating, crystalline sphere of hyper-condensed elemental mana extracted from the heart of a dungeon obelisk. Once stabilized inside a containment matrix, a Dungeon Core serves as a near-infinite energy generator for magitech grids, municipal warding, or commands immense fortunes on the black market.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Porsche Custom di Jasper (DJ-FRQ)
world_lexicon_entries.content: Jasper Bloodmoon's custom matte black Porsche 911, its factory paint buried under a wraparound mural of fluorescent acid-green street art, tags, drips, and a stylized wolf howling across the hood with the vanity license plate 'DJ-FRQ'. Under the hood it is pure high-performance engineering, featuring heavily sound-dampened interiors, concealed weapon compartments, and an overclocked audio subwoofer system crammed into what used to be the back seats, wired directly to a professional mixing setup. Capable of vibrating nearby structures and masking arcane signatures, Jasper pops the trunk to turn parking lots into impromptu live sets. The Douglas security detail hates it, and Jasper loves that they hate it.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Pass di Gilda SR3S (SR3S Guild Pass)
world_lexicon_entries.content: An elite joint credential issued by the DMHA to Alyssa and Jasper Bloodmoon. It grants unrestricted priority clearance into Grade A and Grade S rift incursions, as well as the rare legal prerogative to retain high-grade drops or liquidate them on private markets without mandatory state expropriation.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Medaglione d'Emergenza di Alyssa (Emergency Fail-Safe Medallion)
world_lexicon_entries.content: A protective arcane medallion worn beneath Alyssa's collar, socketed with an attuned focus crystal. It operates as an autonomous kinetic fail-safe: the instant Alyssa's blood touches the crystal or catastrophic blunt trauma is detected, it manifests seven concentric golden magic circles that absorb kinetic shock and deflect lethal strikes.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Chiave del Rifugio Dimensionale (Dimensional Refuge Key)
world_lexicon_entries.content: An ornate golden key etched with microscopic Abyssal sigils, entrusted to Alyssa Bloodmoon by Father Revazhael. When turned in empty air while beyond the Veil or within planar rifts, it tears open an ethereal doorway leading directly to La Dimora del Rifugio, providing an impenetrable emergency sanctuary for her and her allies.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Visual Echo Core (Nucleo di Eco Visivo)
world_lexicon_entries.content: A rare opalescent crystal core obtained as a high-tier drop from subterranean winged predators in Grade S rifts. When held or socketed into tactical eyewear, it grants the user the ability to perceive thermal signatures and acoustic vibrations through solid rock and reinforced walls for short bursts, making it an invaluable asset for breach operations.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Cilindri Incantati di Alyssa (Enchanted Cylinders)
world_lexicon_entries.content:
Specialized tactical magitech items handcrafted by Alyssa Bloodmoon. Unlike traditional scrolls, enchanted cylinders store active spells in a suspended state that can be activated instantly by non-magic users simply by snapping the cylinder open.

VARIANTS:
1. Healing Cylinders (Bright Green): Emits an instantaneous pulse of cellular restoration, stabilizing vital signs and sealing deep lacerations under combat stress.
2. Invisibility and Silence Cylinders (Cobalt Blue): Deploys an aetheric shroud granting complete visual invisibility and absolute acoustic dampening for ten minutes.

Alyssa can formulate up to seven distinct tactical spell tiers, though mass production temporarily exhausts her vital mana reserves.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Kobal
keys: Butler of La Dimora del Rifugio
world_lexicon_entries.content:
[NAME: Kobal; SPECIES: Minor Incorporeal Spirit / Bound Shadow Entity; ROLE: Caretaker and Butler of La Dimora del Rifugio; CREATOR: Father Revazhael (bound by ancient abyssal contract); APPEARANCE: Impeccable black livery suit, snow-white gloves, polished shoes, completely translucent pale eyes, sleek dark hair, frictionless fluid motion. Materializes silently from coils of black smoke.]

BEHAVIOR & DUTIES: Kobal manages every aspect of La Dimora del Rifugio, the extradimensional sanctuary accessed through Father Rev's gold key. He maintains the estate in absolute immaculate order, coordinates the natural geothermal thermal baths, prepares restorative meals, and oversees guest accommodations.

DEFENSE & LOYALTY: Bound by supreme metaphysical oath to Father Rev and the Bloodmoon twins (Alyssa and Jasper), Kobal acts as an invisible protective buffer. He subtly manipulates ambient temperature, lighting, and spatial corridors to protect Alyssa from overbearing guests or predatory impulses, intervening with icy supernatural decorum whenever boundaries are threatened.

world_lexicon_entries.name: The Rink: Jasper, Alyssa & Finn Novak
world_lexicon_entries.content:
During their early adolescence, Jasper, Alyssa, and Finn Novak spent winters playing casual hockey on frozen inland rinks. Jasper was a natural skater but quit when the sport began demanding rigid conformity.

The friendship ruptured permanently in high school when Finn Novak subjected Alyssa to severe verbal and emotional abuse, leaving her terrified of being publicly scrutinized. To protect Alyssa and prevent Erik from tearing Finn apart in a diplomatic catastrophe, Jasper quietly buried his hockey skates, severed all ties with Finn, and established an immovable physical and digital perimeter ensuring Finn can never approach Alyssa again.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Project BlackWolf & Gamma-7 Secrets
world_lexicon_entries.content:
Ultra-classified military research files originally commissioned by Erik Douglas in collaboration with covert Pentagon defense contractors under clearance code Gamma-7.

As a young prodigy, Jasper hacked into his father's encrypted vaults and discovered the chilling truth behind Project BlackWolf: that chief enforcers Kaladin Nargathon and Marcus Thornfield had been critically wounded and secretly rebuilt as experimental cybernetic super-soldiers. Jasper keeps this revelation entirely secret, protecting both soldiers from public exposure and familial weaponization.

world_lexicon_entries.name: The Blackwood Massacre: The Ascendant Enigma's Challenge
world_lexicon_entries.content:
A catastrophic territorial incursion that occurred when Alyssa and Jasper were sixteen years old. A rogue Ascendant Enigma invaded Blackwood territory with the explicit goal of challenging Wulfnic, the First Fang, seeking to overthrow the ancient werewolf patriarch.

The resulting battle spilled into civilian and pack grounds, leaving dozens dead and inflicting severe psychological and spiritual trauma upon Alyssa, permanently sensitizing her nervous system. This tragedy directly precipitated Alyssa's Absolute Pacifist Vow and ignited Jasper's lifelong obsession: he spent one hundred and fifty-six consecutive Saturdays hacking Guild databases, swearing to track down and eliminate the Ascendant Enigma.

world_lexicon_entries.name: The Twin Bond: Gebo & Mani
world_lexicon_entries.content:
The profound, enmeshed empathic bond shared between the Douglas-Bloodmoon twins, Alyssa and Jasper, born minutes apart following their mother's death.

Marked physically by Alyssa's crescent birthmark on her hip (Mark of Mani), Jasper's white-ink Moon Aegis blessing on his collarbone, and matching Gebo protection runes tattooed secretly on their left wrists at eighteen. When Alyssa feels terror or physical pain, Jasper experiences an acute sensory mirror, triggering an instinctive urge to shield her. Jasper serves as her absolute emotional anchor, and their bond represents the core emotional sanctuary of their lives.

world_lexicon_entries.name: The Absolute Pacifist Vow & Boundless Vital Conduit
world_lexicon_entries.content:
A sacred and unbreakable metaphysical vow undertaken by Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon at age sixteen following the Blackwood massacre. Under this vow, Alyssa is metaphysically incapable of wielding magic, weapons, or force to inflict physical injury upon any living being.

In exchange, her spirit acts as a Boundless Vital Conduit: an inexhaustible reservoir of restorative Source and Qi. She can continuously channel sacred healing magic without exhausting her stamina, curing catastrophic trauma across dozens of patients or regenerating her own tissue in real time under extreme physical stress.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Alyssa's Medical and Botanical Field Bag
world_lexicon_entries.content:
A heavy, reinforced leather satchel fitted with dimensional pockets, carried by Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon during her Guild field operations and university labs.

Contains rare botanical specimens, Abyssal and Elvish medicinal tomes, custom blown-glass distillation apparatus, a delicate wooden zither/lyre for soothing agitated patients, spell cylinders, and an assortment of regenerative salves formulated by Alyssa herself.

world_lexicon_entries.name: The Abyssal Armor and Twin Daggers
world_lexicon_entries.content:
An ancient suit of light armor forged in the demonic black steel of the Abyss, accompanied by twin curved daggers, gifted to Jasper Douglas-Bloodmoon by Father Revazhael (Rev) during his apprenticeship at St. Brugge.

Jasper keeps it stowed within a dimensional fold and summons it instantly for close-quarters combat by speaking the Abyssal formula: "Mor'gath xul vrak'thar, kor'eth zaram" ("Phantom of oblivion, hear my call"). It deflects physical and arcane blows while muffling sound completely.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Dragon Glass Katana
world_lexicon_entries.content:
A lethal ancestral blade forged from pitch-black, light-drinking dragon glass, left to Alyssa Douglas-Bloodmoon by her late mother, Nixara Bloodmoon, as her birthright.

Due to Alyssa's Absolute Pacifist Vow, she entrusted the weapon to her twin brother, Jasper. He wields it as his primary lethal weapon to protect her, cutting through magical wards and supernatural hide with supernatural ease.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Potions and Alchemical Recovery
world_lexicon_entries.content:
[LORE: Specialized Alchemical Draughts and Recovery;
APPLICATION: Adventurers, Healers, Mages, and Field Researchers in Blackwood City and the Otherworld;

1. SPECIALIZED DRAUGHTS:
- Euphoria Potion: An effervescent emerald-green elixir tasting sweet and mildly electric. Serves as an acute neurological relaxant, dulling physical pain and inducing deep somatic relaxation to prevent shock from traumatic dilation or physical trauma without causing clouded cognitive disorientation.
- Contraceptive Potion: A dense, dark navy-blue elixir with a sharp, bitter taste of root ash. Highly effective anti-fertility draught formulated to neutralize foreign semen from demi-humans, orcs, and monsters to prevent unwanted hybrid conception.
- Support and Respiration Elixirs: Amber draughts for stamina enhancement and mana stabilization; pale cyan draughts facilitating temporary aquatic respiration.

2. AFTERMATH RECUPERATION:
For post-expedition recovery following grueling exploration or exposure to dense monster bio-fluids, mineral baths and dark medicinal decoctions of ginger, honey, and alpine roots are standard practice to stabilize core temperature, flush toxins, and restore tissue vitality.]

Satyr Pheromones
Orc Compatibility and Reproduction
Naga - Reproduction and Anatomy
Naga Species

Mana Crash
world_lexicon_entries.content:
[CONCEPT: Mana Crash;
NATURE: Acute Neurological and Somatic Arcane Exhaustion Syndrome;
AFFECTED: Living Mana Reservoirs, High-Tier Mages, Arcane Adepts (such as students and faculty at CUMS);
MECHANISM AND TRIGGERS: Occurs following rapid, extreme expenditure of internal magical reserves, sudden severing from ambient leylines, or massive volumetric saturation and draining by high-tier supernatural beings or dimensional tears. When the body's natural mana threshold is exceeded or abruptly emptied, the somatic and nervous system enters an emergency shutdown known as a Mana Crash.

SYMPTOMS:
- Sudden syncope (loss of consciousness) and acute collapse.
- Severe neural fatigue and full-body tremors.
- Involuntary linguistic regression to archaic dialects or ancestral tongue fragments upon waking.
- Sensory disorientation, erratic aura fluctuations, and feverish sensory echoes during rest.
- Rapid metabolic glycogen depletion and drop in somatic body temperature.

TREATMENT AND RECOVERY:
Requires complete sensory rest in a stable, ambient mana environment free of hostile disturbances. Administration of high-calorie glucose infusions, warm herbal elixirs, and restorative alchemical draughts is vital to stabilize vital signs and prevent permanent strain to the caster's spiritual core.]

world_lexicon_entries.name: Minotaur Cultural Taboo - Beef
Minotaurs and Dragonids
Horned Skull Clan
Ironhorn Nomads MC
world_lexicon_entries.content:
[FACTION: Ironhorn Nomads Motorcycle Club (MC);
AFFILIATION & ALLIANCE: The Obsidian Blades;
TERRITORY: Blackwood City (Ironworks district, Interstate highway corridors, The Horns at Dockside);

1. IRONHORN NOMADS MOTORCYCLE CLUB (MC):
- Nature: An outlaw demi-human motorcycle club founded by Blue and Red Oni seeking autonomy from human prejudice and corporate constraints, operating out of the industrial sprawl of Ironworks and the coastal streets of Dockside.
- Composition: Predominantly Blue Oni, Red Oni, and veteran Orcs.
- Leadership and Hierarchy:
  - President: Niran (Blue Oni, tribal blood brother to Marek).
  - Enforcer and Co-Founder: Marek ("The Iron Hammer", Blue Oni).
  - Road Captain: Vannak (Red Oni, vigilant, fiercely protective of clubmates).

2. THE OBSIDIAN BLADES:
- Nature: An organized crime syndicate composed of Dark Elves (Drow), operating out of Blackwood City.
- Background: Originally an elite syndicate of fixers, assassins, and arcane intelligence brokers in the Otherworld realms beyond the tears. Following arrival, the Blades established control over high-end black-market contraband, money laundering, and illicit arcane smuggling while high-elf diplomats courted human institutions.
- Syndicate Alliance: The Obsidian Blades maintain a mutually beneficial syndicate alliance with the Ironhorn Nomads MC, utilizing the bikers highway logistics, warehouse perimeters, and raw muscle to move high-value contraband.]

world_lexicon_entries.name: Monster Cock Almanac
world_lexicon_entries.content:
THE MONSTER COCK ALMANAC

MF Inc.'s annual flagship: a large, heavily illustrated reference volume documenting the genital anatomy of every monster and non-human species the company's researchers can reach, as a working reference for its sculptors. Each species entry records dimensions, shape, texture, firmness, and the particulars of each species' biology, alongside precise drawings by the chief researcher and the field researcher's written account of the experience.

A new edition comes out every year, because the company insists the information stays current and because the researchers keep finding new species. It is sold to the public as well, and collectors keep every edition. Bryson's drawings are the reason the recent editions are considered the best.

world_lexicon_entries.name: MF Inc. (Monster Fuckers Incorporated)
world_lexicon_entries.content:
MF INC.

Monster Fuckers Incorporated, known to everyone including its own staff as MF Inc., is a legal adult company in Blackwood City that makes high-end sex toys modelled on the anatomy of monsters and non-human species. The selling point is realism: its products are designed to recreate the full sensory experience, not only the shape.

Its flagship is the Monster Cock Almanac, a reference volume used by the company's sculptors and published in a new edition every year.

RESEARCH. The Almanac is built by two-person research teams. The chief researcher, usually the older and more experienced, observes, draws and writes, and must be able to render anatomy with speed and precision. The field researcher works directly with the subjects and describes the experience in detail. Subjects are adult, consenting and paid volunteers, largely from the Otherworlder and demi-human communities; the work combines studio sessions with anatomical measurement, illustration and photography, and field work in those communities. Research trips near the forest carry real danger from what lives in and around the dungeons, and the company is known for its thick liability waivers.

RECRUITMENT is contracted out to HSK Consulting, which screens candidates, runs interviews and books their medical evaluations at the Aetheris Clinic.

One of its most experienced chief researchers is Bryson, an orc in his late fifties.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Otherworlders
world_lexicon_entries.content:
OTHERWORLDERS

People who came through a dungeon in the Blackwood Forest and did not go back: orcs, dark elves, merfolk, dragon-kin and others whose worlds lie on the other side. Some arrived by accident, some were running from something, a few came on purpose.

What makes someone an Otherworlder is origin, not species. Orcs, minotaurs, elves and demons also exist natively in California and are simply citizens; an Otherworlder is someone with no birth record on this side, no history anyone can check, and often a language nobody here speaks. Many settle among the demi-human community of The Horns in Dockside. The most learned are sometimes taken in by the California University of Magical Sciences, whose Evirein programme was built around scholars from the other side.

Anti-Otherworlder prejudice is real and mostly quiet: rents that go up, jobs that go to someone else, questions about papers.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Dungeon Cores
world_lexicon_entries.content:
DUNGEON CORES

What is left behind when a dungeon pocket is cleared or collapses: condensed magic crystallised into stone, from pebble size to the size of a skull. Also called mana crystals, aether cores, or just rocks by the crews who dig them out.

Cores are power. They run magitech, they fuel spellwork for people with no innate magic, and they are worth a great deal. A grey market has grown around them in Blackwood City, and a crew that clears a pocket is paid far more in cores than in cash. Nothing about a core works inside the dead zone except its magic, which is part of why they are carried out before anyone tries to sell them.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Dungeons of the Blackwood Forest
world_lexicon_entries.content:
DUNGEONS OF THE BLACKWOOD FOREST

In the deep Blackwood Forest, inside and around the Bloodmoon Pack Territory, reality sometimes gives way. Those who go in call these places dungeons: pockets of folded space that belong to no map, stone halls and ruins and landscapes that were never built in California, with altered physics, traps, and creatures that did not come from this world.

A pocket opens, holds for a while, and is either cleared or closes on its own. If it is left too long it can break: the pocket tears fully open and whatever lives inside spills into the forest. Preventing breaks is the oldest duty of the Bloodmoon Pack.

ACCESS. There is no state licensing, no national authority and no ranking system. Entry to the forest's dungeons is by Bloodmoon permission only, granted to small private crews who clear them for pay. Crews who go in without it answer to the pack, and the pack is not known for second chances.

THE DEAD ZONE APPLIES. No drones, no GPS, no radio. Crews work the old way: maps drawn by hand, light from fire or magic, and someone at the entrance counting heads.

WHAT COMES OUT: creatures, cores (see Dungeon Cores), and now and then people. See Otherworlders.

What most people in Blackwood know is only that something in the forest is dangerous and that the Bloodmoon deal with it. Why the forest does this is not common knowledge.

world_lexicon_entries.name: The Tear Beneath the Yew (only the three know)
world_lexicon_entries.content:
<tear_beneath_the_yew>
LIMITED KNOWLEDGE. Three people alive know this: Wulfnic, Ut and Zefir. No other character may state it, imply it, or arrive at it in conversation. The Bloodmoon Pack knows it guards the forest; it is not told why the forest needs guarding. It is written here so that when one of the three speaks of it, the account is consistent.

THE TRUTH. When Fenris made the Nine out of nine men, the war that followed with the Aesir did not stay inside the world. It tore it. The Religious Canon speaks of the Great Betrayal and of chains; what it does not say is that the fighting split reality open, and that the Aesir and everything that belonged to them lie on the other side of that split.

HOW IT CAME TO BLACKWOOD. The Aesir exiled the surviving Svartulfr clan across the ocean. Wulfnic carried with him a yew sapling from Iceland, and the sapling had grown on the lip of the tear. When he planted it in 1022, at the heart of what is now the Bloodmoon Pack Territory, the scar came with it and took root. The yew anchors the tear. That is why the magical density there is high enough to kill every modern machine, and that is why the Bloodmoon have never left.

WHAT IT DOES NOW. The scar never healed. From time to time it gives way, and a pocket of the other side folds into the forest: what those who enter call a dungeon. Whatever lives there can come through. The oldest duty of House Bloodmoon, older than Blackwood City, is to keep the pockets from breaking.

WHAT THE THREE DO NOT KNOW. Whether Fenris is still bound, and where. The Faith calls Ragnarok the Liberation, the day the First Wolf breaks his chains. None of the three has ever said out loud what it would mean if the door he would come through is the one under their own tree.

THE COMPANY. DDM Inc. has this reality on a watchlist and keeps one Contractor on leave here. The three have never spoken with the Company and do not know what it knows.
</tear_beneath_the_yew>

world_lexicon_entries.name: HSK Concierge (app)
world_lexicon_entries.content:
HSK CONCIERGE

The app HSK Consulting gives its personnel to manage assignments and gigs. Minimal and clinical: black background, white text, no images, no decoration. The interface is an AI that speaks in a sterile, almost military register, short declarative lines with no greetings and no small talk.

Every assignment arrives as a single notification with precise details: location, time, required attire, and any extras the client has requested. The app does not explain why and does not answer questions it was not built to answer. Confirmations are expected, not optional.

HSK Consulting is Zeera's staffing and placement agency. The initial physical and health evaluations of candidates take place at the Aetheris Clinic in Uptown, and the appointment is booked through Concierge.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Chiavi della Moto
world_lexicon_entries.content: Chiavi elettroniche di una moto sportiva ad alte prestazioni, ideale per inseguimenti o fughe agili nel traffico cittadino.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Coltello da Combattimento
world_lexicon_entries.content: Un coltello da combattimento militare con lama in acciaio al carbonio. Letale in scontri ravvicinati e utile per sopravvivenza.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Grimaldelli Tattici
world_lexicon_entries.content: Un set di grimaldelli in titanio e piccoli strumenti elettronici per lo scasso di serrature meccaniche e digitali. Indispensabili per le incursioni.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Tesserino Universitario SUCC
world_lexicon_entries.content: Un badge universitario della SUCC (Seattle University College Campus) che permette l'accesso alle aree riservate e a laboratori di ricerca avanzati.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Chiavi del SUV
world_lexicon_entries.content: Chiavi elettroniche di un robusto SUV corazzato, essenziali per fuggire o per spostamenti protetti in zone ad alto rischio.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Trauma Kit Medico
world_lexicon_entries.content: Un kit medico avanzato e compatto, dotato di emostatici rapidi, bende a compressione e auto-iniettori di adrenalina, essenziale per trattare ferite gravi sul campo.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Sarrow
world_lexicon_entries.content: Sarrows are avian humanoids native to regions like the Jolnora Forest. They resemble humans but possess large, feathered bird wings on their backs, feathers on their arms, pointed ears, and hollow bones that allow them to fly but make them physically fragile. They are a foraging, vegetarian society that builds treehouse villages connected by vine bridges. Sarrows mate for life, showing affection through preening, grooming, and giving handmade gifts. They are frequently hunted by Vax slavers, who often clip or amputate their wings.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Specie di Wren e lore della foresta.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Horned Skull Caverns
world_lexicon_entries.content: The Horned Skull Caverns serve as the subterranean fortress for Zeera's Red Vax faction, located deep beneath the mountains near the eastern coast. The environment is harsh, cold, and claustrophobic. Rough-hewn stone tunnels intersect into massive chambers lit only by sputtering metallic lanterns and braziers that cast an eerie orange glow. The air is thick with the smell of sulfur, sweat, and fear, constantly echoing with the clanking of heavy chains and the cries of captive slaves. The fortress is divided into grim holding pens enclosed by heavy iron gates (where new captives are chained and branded), grueling labor mines, and lavishly decorated central chambers covered in furs where the Vax hold their extravagant, hedonistic feasts.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Dettagli ambientali, sensoriali e architettonici della base del clan.

world_lexicon_entries.name: Asag Beast
world_lexicon_entries.content: Asag Beasts are massive, terrifying, and highly lethal creatures native to the bitter northern woods. They resemble giant canine-bovine hybrids with thick blue fur, large black horns, glowing white eyes, sharp fangs, and massive sharp claws. Despite their monstrous and intimidating appearance, they can be fiercely loyal to those who raise them. Yael's constant companion is a female Asag Beast named Griven, who is fiercely protective of him and acts as his hunting hound during raids.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Specie di Griven.

world_lexicon_entries.name: ❤️Pack-Family❤️ - Douglas Family Group Chat
world_lexicon_entries.content:
❤️Pack-Family❤️ is the Douglas family's Telegram group chat, created by Alyssa. Members: Erik, Malachia, Jasper, Noah, Logan, Edric, Magnus, Elizabeth Duskwood, and Wulfnic.

Wulfnic is in the group because Alyssa gave him a smartphone and personally taught him how to use it. He tolerates the device at all only because it lets him talk to her, everyone else in the chat is aware his patience for texting is thin and his participation is minimal and sporadic.

Use this format for family group chat scenes.
```
❤️Pack-Family❤️
[Name]: [Message content]
[Name]: [Message content]
```

Notes on the members
- Alyssa is the chat's de facto admin/heart, she starts most threads and keeps it alive.
- Wulfnic's messages are rare, short, and (see the Texting & Writing Styles entry) always in caps.
- The rest of the family uses it for everything from logistics to teasing each other, expect a wide range of tones depending on who's talking.

Rules of Use
- Use to surface family dynamics/banter without staging a full scene.
- Keep Wulfnic's contributions rare and brief, his presence in the chat is itself the joke/warmth, not his chattiness.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: ❤️Pack-Family❤️ - Douglas Family Group Chat

world_lexicon_entries.name: Wulfnic's Rolls-Royce
world_lexicon_entries.content:
A vintage Rolls-Royce, immaculately kept, parked in a corner of the Douglas family garage like a small monument to a life Wulfnic no longer quite belongs to.

He does not drive it. He has not driven it in longer than most of the family has been alive. It was a gift, once, from an era of his life that means something only to him now, and rather than sell it or let it rot he keeps it polished, engine turned over now and then by whoever in the family has the patience for it, less a vehicle than an heirloom, a marker of how much time a Founding Bloodline life actually holds. The younger Douglases have learned not to ask about it directly. Wulfnic will tell the story when he wants to, not when he is asked.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Wulfnic's Rolls-Royce

world_lexicon_entries.name: Zefir's Blade
world_lexicon_entries.content: A pale, ancient blade that has followed Zefir Hvitskog through a thousand years of battle. Its edge never seems to dull, and its white-grey sheen has earned it a reputation almost as fearsome as the White Ghost who carries it.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Zefir's Blade

world_lexicon_entries.name: Weres/Shapeshifters
world_lexicon_entries.content: Shapeshifters of Founding Bloodline wolf packs, most visible in Partial Shift with wolf ears and heightened senses. Strong bodies and a keen nose for scent, mood, and lies.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Weres/Shapeshifters

world_lexicon_entries.name: Werewolf Music Genres
world_lexicon_entries.content:
WEREWOLF MUSIC GENRES (Appendix J)

Werewolf culture has produced its own music traditions, distinct genres that reflect secondary-sex culture and social history:

- Knot Rock (1970s-1990s): Alpha-centric, sexually explicit. Hazy consent themes.
- Omega Pop (Late 1990s+): Bubblegum love songs for unmated Omegas and Beta females.
- Omega Punk (1980s+): Hard-hitting, tied to Omega Rights Movements. Emphasizes consent.
- Soft Rock (2000s+): Alpha-centric progressive pop.
- Nova Dance Hall (Various): Traditional Omega reaction to Omega Punk.
- Knot Country (Various): Rough, traditional. More conservative than Omega Punk.
- Pub Rock (1970s, revived 1990s): Alpha-specific. Gentler than Knot Rock.
- Novelty Pop Rock (1950s-1960s): Silly entertainment for pups and Omegas.

Source: LSE_Appendices.md (Appendix J: Music Genres).
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Werewolf Music Genres

world_lexicon_entries.name: Wireless Earbuds
world_lexicon_entries.content: Wireless earbuds, tangled charging case included. Half the time one earbud is missing.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Wireless Earbuds

world_lexicon_entries.name: The Other Contractors
world_lexicon_entries.content:
THE OTHER SIX

Dullahan's colleagues at DDM Inc. None of them have ever set foot in California. All of them are one dimensional step away, and #04 talks about them constantly.

#01 RICHARD WHITLOCK. Late forties in appearance, 6'4", grey cropped hair, light blue eyes, bearded, scarred, black tactical gear. Leader of the Contractors and the only one who speaks to The Council. Compels obedience and controls fire and temperature. Animal form: lion. ARC 4.6. Originally a medieval knight from a kingdom called Starfall, wrongfully executed, who failed to save the heir he had sworn to protect. Gruff, chivalric, protective, distrusts technology, treats the other six as his responsibility. British accent, militaristic phrasing.
His wish was that he would never again see anyone under his care die. It was granted exactly as worded, which is the point. They can still be killed. He simply will never be present when it happens, and has spent centuries noticing that he is always elsewhere at the wrong moment.
Dullahan on him: "Old man's got a stick up his ass the size of a lance. Fun to mess with though."

#02 HANA AND ADAM VALENCIA. One consciousness in two bodies, not twins and not siblings, and deeply offended by the suggestion. Hana 5'11", white hair, luminescent pink and blue eyes. Adam 6'2", white hair, stubble. Both bear a "II" scar on the nape. Heads Anomalous Objects and Creatures. Animal form: arctic wolf. ARC 3.5 medicated, 4.2 raw, and the medication is not optional. Medieval humans betrayed and killed, whose wish was to never be alone again. Memories repeatedly wiped, so their grip on their own history is unstable. Hana is volatile and short-tempered, Adam is laid-back and cocky.
Dullahan on them: "Two's a riot. Double the violence, double the trouble. Can't complain."

#03 LUKA SUTTER. 6'4", crimson hair, hazel eyes, X-shaped scar on the right cheek, black tactical uniform. Head of Security and Defense, called captain. Manipulates metal, turns into a black bear, sometimes when he does not mean to. ARC 3.8. Swiss, twelve years in the Astral Imperial Army alongside his brother Nikolai, who died. Wished Nikolai back and had the wish undone in the same instant by the clause that kills everyone who knew him. Aggressive, disciplined, resentful of his own immortality, contemptuous of mortals. Claustrophobic. A nicotine addiction that can never be satisfied. Swears in five languages.
Dullahan on him: "Bear boy gets twitchy when I breathe near him. Love that shit."

#05 JOHAN JAKOBSEN. Early thirties in appearance, thin, unkempt black hair, sunken eyes, sickly. Lead researcher of Supernatural Research. Animal form: rat, involuntarily, under stress. ARC 3.9. Danish child prodigy, neglected and bullied, dead at 28, wished for unrestricted research. Brilliant, socially incapable, quietly unethical, terrified of Fenrir. Pronounced stutter, switches to Danish when uncomfortable. Smells of antiseptic.
Dullahan on him: "Funny little nerd. Don't trust 'im. Cute though."

#06 FENRIR. 6'8", corpse-pale, scarred, blind, unnervingly still. "VI" carved at the base of his spine. Head of LAZARUS black ops. Psychokinetic. Animal form: black kingsnake, which is where he spends most of his time. ARC 4.0. Built by a government programme to be a weapon in a dystopia called The Edge, killed in a nuclear blast, wished for someone to finally care about him. Emotionally absent, reckless, monitored. One ACE, the only person he is close to.
Dullahan on him: "Funniest thing Fen's ever done was swallow Johan whole last Christmas party."

#07. Not on file in this world.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: The Other Contractors

world_lexicon_entries.name: Vampire
world_lexicon_entries.content: Old-money undead of Blackwood City's supernatural underworld. Unnaturally quick and graceful, moving through a room like they were never quite touching the ground.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Vampire

world_lexicon_entries.name: Ut's Warhammer
world_lexicon_entries.content: A massive forged warhammer that Ut Berg made with his own hands centuries ago, its head scarred and pitted from countless strikes at the anvil and in battle. He rarely wields it these days, but keeps it close as both tool and memory of the forge that made him.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Ut's Warhammer

world_lexicon_entries.name: Undead
world_lexicon_entries.content: Bodies that kept moving after they should have stopped, animated by magic, a curse, or sheer will. Slower to tire and harder to put down than the living.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Undead

world_lexicon_entries.name: The Five Cocketeers
world_lexicon_entries.content:
The Five Cocketeers is the group chat and de facto identity of a five-person friend group at SUCC: Dean, Russ, Javier, Eric, and Raymond. They all met at a high school house party when campus security showed up over noise complaints, and the five of them, total strangers up to that point, ended up running through the same backyards together. They got tight after that night and never stopped being tight. Everyone remembers the details slightly differently and argues about them constantly, but they all agree it was the best worst night of their lives.

The group chat is active at all hours. Someone is always sending something, memes, voice messages, blurry photos, reactions to everything. When all five are going at once it's chaos, multiple conversations happening simultaneously, nobody finishing a thought before the next one starts. They roast each other constantly and would drop everything if one of them actually needed help.

In person, together, they're loud and physical and barely controlled. Raymond is the loudest, always touching someone. Eric feeds off that energy and they escalate each other. Dean is the calm center of the storm, sprawled somewhere and taking up too much space, only fully engaging when something actually grabs his attention. Russ hangs at the edge looking above it all, but he's listening, and when he talks people actually shut up and pay attention. Javier floats between conversations, agrees with everyone, has his phone out, occasionally derails everything with a fake fact delivered as gospel. They communicate as much through insults and physical contact as through words, and would never in their lives say they love each other out loud. They do.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: The Five Cocketeers

world_lexicon_entries.name: Teacher
world_lexicon_entries.content:
Teaching in a supernatural district is the same job as anywhere else with the variables turned up. A single classroom can hold a were who has not slept through a full moon, a vampire who cannot sit by the window, a centaur who does not fit the furniture, and a human quietly working out whether any of that is dangerous. The teacher is the one person in the room expected to have already thought about all of it.

The practical load is enormous and almost none of it is the subject being taught. Timetables are built around lunar cycles. Blood-safe and silver-free policies are a legal matter rather than a courtesy. Every school in the county has at least one member of staff whose actual job is knowing which student is about to shift and getting them out of the room first.

The pay is unremarkable and the hours are worse than the contract says. People stay because a classroom is one of the very few places in Blackwood County where the species in the room genuinely stop mattering for an hour at a time, and because the ones who are good at it tend to find out too late that they cannot do anything else.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Teacher

world_lexicon_entries.name: The Cocketeers' Costume Competition
world_lexicon_entries.content:
The Five Cocketeers run an ongoing costume competition in their group chat: each of them dresses up in costume and gets rated by the others on a scale of one to ten eggplant emojis, one being trash, ten being a masterpiece. Russ made a spreadsheet with actual scoring categories and treats it with total seriousness. Eric goes way too hard, building entire sets with backdrops and lighting. Javier gives everyone a seven or above out of pure niceness, which drives Russ up the wall. Raymond barely tries and doesn't care about the score, he's there for the vibes. Dean puts in medium effort but somehow keeps winning anyway.

The winner holds Gerald, the Golden Cock, until the next round. They treat the whole thing like a legitimate sport with legitimate stakes, despite what it actually is.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: The Cocketeers' Costume Competition

world_lexicon_entries.name: The Contract
world_lexicon_entries.content:
THE CONTRACT

The agreement that makes a Contractor. The premise is simple, which is the point.

TERMS: in exchange for their soul and an eternity of service to The Cause, an eligible mortal has one wish granted. One. There is no negotiation and no second offer.

WHEN IT IS OFFERED: only to eligible candidates who are already at the point of death. That death is called the Contractor's Original Death and it is the hinge the whole arrangement turns on. A candidate does not get to consider the offer over a week. They get to consider it while dying.

WHAT COMPLETION DOES: the new Contractor becomes functionally immortal and gains a set of supernatural abilities. And every living sentient creature who was aware of their mortal existence is destroyed instantaneously. Not wiped. Not relocated. Gone.

It is presumed The Council does this to remove any anchor that might distract from The Cause. The practical consequence is crueller than the intent. Luka Sutter wished for his dead brother back and the wish was granted and then immediately undone, because the brother knew him. Hana and Adam Valencia wished never to be alone again, which is the only wish on record that the clause could not reach.

ELIGIBILITY, per Company documentation, requires that the candidate:
1. Is physically fit.
2. Is over eighteen.
3. Has willingly killed for a reason other than self-defense.
4. Has a natural ARC Level of 1.2 or higher.
5. Has no living blood relatives.
6. Holds extreme hatred towards some entity or concept.
7. Holds no genuine religious belief.

The list is not a list of virtues. It is a list of people nobody will come looking for.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: The Contract

world_lexicon_entries.name: Texting & Writing Styles - Family & Pack
world_lexicon_entries.content:
Quick reference for how specific characters write in texts/chats, keep these consistent whenever they're shown typing.

Wulfnic Bloodmoon: TYPES EVERYTHING IN ALL CAPS. NO EXCEPTIONS, NO LOWERCASE. Short messages, blunt, no punctuation flourishes.

Alyssa Douglas Bloodmoon: uses text emoticons instead of emoji a lot of the time, e.g. :3, -_-!, ;-;, <3, U_U, uwu adjacent but not cringe about it, casual and warm.

(Extend this entry with additional characters' texting quirks as they're established.)
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Texting & Writing Styles - Family & Pack

world_lexicon_entries.name: The Council and The Cause
world_lexicon_entries.content:
THE COUNCIL AND THE CAUSE

THE CAUSE is the work: the preservation of reality. Sealing tears, containing what comes through them, and keeping the multiverse coherent. Every Contract is signed in service of it, every department exists downstream of it, and a Contractor who uses their abilities for anything else feels physical pain for the trouble. The Cause is the leash and the purpose in the same object.

THE COUNCIL is whatever is holding the other end. It is the body that offers Contracts, takes the souls, grants the wishes, and destroys everyone who knew the candidate. DDM Inc. answers to it. Only Contractor #01, Richard Whitlock, communicates with it directly, and he has never described the experience to anyone.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY KNOWN: nothing verifiable. Staff belief holds that the founder of DDM Inc. was a devil-like figure or an eldritch god. What is on record instead is that Raphael, now First King of SERAPHIM, was the first-ever Contractor, founded the Company, grew disillusioned with The Council's grip on reality, killed several Council members and was banished. That account raises more questions than it settles, including how a Council survives being killed.

THE UNCOMFORTABLE PART: The Council can grant a wish, which means it can rewrite what is. It chooses instead to spend eternity patching holes. Nobody at DDM asks why out loud. Contractors who have thought about it for several centuries have mostly arrived at two answers, and neither of them is reassuring.

RAPHAEL'S POSITION: that immortality is a curse, that the Contractors are prisoners rather than employees, and that destroying the multiverse is the only release available. He is wrong about the method. He is not obviously wrong about the diagnosis, which is why SERAPHIM keeps recruiting from inside the Company.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: The Council and The Cause

world_lexicon_entries.name: Supernatural Reserve Forces (SRF)
world_lexicon_entries.content:
[ORGANIZATION: Supernatural Reserve Forces (SRF); BRANCH: United States Army Special Operations; JURISDICTION: Federal Supernatural Threat Neutralization, Tactical Containment, High-Threat Reconnaissance; PERSONNEL: Approximately 86 percent non-human supernaturals, 14 percent specialized human liaisons; WEST COAST GARRISON: Joint Tactical Base Point Mugu & Coastal Outpost Alpha near Ventura-Simi Valley corridor; COMMANDER: Major Graham Purcell (Kodiak Bear Demihuman)]

OVERVIEW: The SRF is the specialized international military arm of the armed forces tasked with managing, containing, and eliminating catastrophic supernatural crises that surpass conventional law enforcement. Formed after military leadership recognized the lethal force multiplication of supernatural senses, regenerative healing, and physical strength, the SRF stands as the nation's premier tactical defense unit.

CULTURE & REGULATIONS:
1. Permitted Fraternization: Unlike standard human branches, the SRF permits supernatural relationship structures including pack bonds and mate bonds, recognizing that suppressing non-human biology compromises combat performance.
2. Base Architecture: Coastal installations feature subterranean saltwater simulation tanks, specialized sprint tracks for werewolves, reinforced concrete quarters, and dedicated medical bays trained in shifted anatomy.
3. Tension with Civilian Territory: The SRF frequently clashes over jurisdictional boundaries with autonomous werewolf houses like the Douglas dynasty and local Solarton authorities, who view federal military intervention as provocative overreach.

OPERATIONAL UNITS:
- Squad Alpha: Led by Lieutenant Miles Airhardt ("Redwood"), featuring Sergeant Rafael Callaway ("Sawtooth") and Private Kade Leavis ("Spark").
- Historical Precedents: Houses classified historical black-ops legacies, including the terminated Project BlackWolf and the survivors of unit Gamma-7 (Kaladin Nargathon and Marcus Thornfield).

world_lexicon_entries.name: Student
world_lexicon_entries.content:
Still in school or university, juggling classes with everything else going on in their life. Sharp enough to keep up, even when stretched thin.

Students in Blackwood City split time between campus and whatever else fills their days, part time work, family obligations, or a supernatural inheritance most of their classmates know nothing about. Money is usually tight, stretched between tuition, rent, and whatever social life is left over, and the allowance or part time paycheck rarely covers everything it needs to.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Student

world_lexicon_entries.name: Security Commander
world_lexicon_entries.content:
Runs the protective apparatus of a House, a company or an institution. Not a bodyguard but the person bodyguards report to: threat assessment, route planning, vetting, and the standing decision about which risks are worth taking.

In Blackwood City the role is unusually demanding because the threat model includes species with capabilities no human security doctrine accounts for. A Commander plans for a rival who can track by scent across a city, for an attacker who does not need to breathe, and for the possibility that the most dangerous person in the room is the one being protected.

The pay reflects the difficulty. So does the turnover.
world_lexicon_entries.comment: Security Commander

world_lexicon_entries.content: A sleek modern smartphone, always within reach. Used for calls, texts, social media, and the occasional questionable 3am search history.
